title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**
Y-Axis Overseas Careers is a global leader in immigration and visa consulting, specializing in personalized services for immigration, visas, overseas jobs, and English language test coaching. With over a million customers served and 100,000 inquiries handled each month, the company operates more than 50 offices worldwide and employs around 1,500 consultants. Y-Axis is recognized as one of the largest B2C visa and immigration companies, supporting individuals who wish to work, study, visit, migrate, or invest in destinations such as the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Singapore, and Norway. The company also provides coaching for exams including IELTS, PTE, TOEFL iBT, OET, CELPIP, SAT, GRE, and GMAT, and is known for processing a high volume of visa and immigration cases in India with strong success rates. Y-Axis positions itself as a comprehensive advisor for global study, career, and relocation options.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Content Writer role based in Hyderabad. The Content Writer will create clear, engaging, and accurate content for the company’s website, blogs, landing pages, email campaigns, and marketing materials, aligned with Y-Axis’s brand voice and business goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include researching immigration, visa, overseas education, and career-related topics, drafting and revising content, and collaborating with marketing, sales, and counselling teams to develop informative resources for prospective clients. The role involves optimizing web content for readability and user engagement, ensuring consistency of messaging across channels, and maintaining up-to-date information based on changing regulations and market trends. The Content Writer will also support content planning, contribute ideas for campaigns, and adhere to deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Web Content Writing and Writing skills for digital platforms and customer-facing communication.
* Candidates should possess solid Content Strategy and Research skills to plan, structure, and develop relevant, accurate topics and narratives.
* Candidates should possess careful Proofreading skills to ensure error-free, consistent, and professional content.
* Candidates should possess excellent command of written English, including grammar, vocabulary, and style, with the ability to adapt tone for different audiences.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in immigration, overseas education, or related domains, or a strong interest and ability to learn these areas quickly.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* A bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or a related field is preferred, along with familiarity with basic SEO principles and web publishing tools.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Overview**

Role Overview

Knowledge Management (KM) is a critical enabler of Financial Planning's strategic priorities, supporting efficient and effective service delivery across PepsiCo's global operations while enhancing employee experience and operational excellence.

The FPT ESM & KM Senior Analyst plays a key role in driving the implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Knowledge Management and Enterprise Service Management (ESM) practices within the Financial Planning (FP) function. Working closely with the FP ESM & KM Lead, this role supports the deployment of KM frameworks, knowledge platforms, service management processes, service performance measurement, and service portfolio management.

As PepsiCo continues to expand its digital capabilities, including the adoption of ServiceNow and other knowledge management technologies, this role will partner with business, IT, and KM Center of Excellence (CoE) teams to ensure effective knowledge capture, governance, accessibility, and service management enablement across the global Financial Planning organization.

The role allocation is approximately:

* 80% Knowledge Management (KM)
* 20% Enterprise Service Management (ESM)

**Responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities

Knowledge Management (80%)

Knowledge Management Program Support

* Support the end-to-end Knowledge Management program, including KM framework deployment, system administration, content governance, document management, and business-critical knowledge retention.
* Partner with the FP ESM & KM Lead to drive KM best practices, governance standards, and continuous improvement initiatives across the Financial Planning organization.

Knowledge Repository Management

* Manage and maintain ServiceNow Knowledge Management content, including 4,000+ Desktop Procedures (DTPs), ensuring information remains accurate, relevant, and accessible.
* Collaborate with capability leads, sector leads, and functional teams to identify, create, update, and retire knowledge assets.
* Ensure knowledge content is structured, categorized, and aligned to capability frameworks to improve discoverability and standardization.
* Partner with the central KM team to create and maintain a centralized knowledge library for S&T teams, ensuring seamless access to trusted and up-to-date information that enhances productivity, promotes knowledge reuse, and accelerates issue resolution across the organization.
* Drive adoption of knowledge-sharing best practices across teams to improve content accessibility and knowledge reuse.

Knowledge Standardization & Adoption

* Drive content quality standards, governance processes, metadata management, and exception handling practices.
* Support the creation and maintenance of standardized knowledge taxonomies and article structures.
* Promote adoption and effective use of ServiceNow Knowledge Management, Epiplex, ARIS, and other knowledge-sharing platforms.

Knowledge Authoring & Process Documentation

* Support implementation of modern knowledge authoring methodologies and tools.
* Facilitate process knowledge capture through interactive documentation, process simulations, videos, and process maps.
* Drive adoption of ARIS for process documentation and process mapping activities.

Knowledge Retention & Continuous Improvement

* Maintain knowledge lifecycle management processes, including regular review, validation, and archival activities.
* Ensure critical process knowledge is retained and updated to support workforce transitions, cross-training, and business continuity requirements.
* Monitor knowledge effectiveness metrics and recommend enhancements to optimize user experience and knowledge reuse.

Knowledge Transfer & Transition Support

* Partner with Design & Transition teams to establish and implement knowledge transfer methodologies and KM ways of working.
* Support onboarding, transition, and capability-building initiatives through structured knowledge capture and sharing practices.

Controls & Compliance

* Support KM-related controls testing activities and ensure compliance with internal control requirements, audit standards, and corporate policies.
* Drive timely remediation of observations and continuous process improvements.

Enterprise Service Management (20%)

Service Management Enablement

* Gather, analyse, document, and maintain business requirements for service management solutions across the Financial Planning organization.
* Partner with the FP ESM & KM Lead to assess, prioritize, and manage service management enhancements and initiatives.

ServiceNow Solution Support

* Support the design, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of ServiceNow-based service management solutions.
* Contribute to delivering a unified, intuitive, and employee-centric service experience across Financial Planning teams.

Backlog & Roadmap Management

* Monitor and manage service management requirements and enhancement backlogs to ensure alignment with strategic priorities.
* Support roadmap planning and future-state service management initiatives in collaboration with ESM CoE and business stakeholders.

Process Governance & Adoption

* Partner with FP service delivery teams and ESM CoE to ensure consistent implementation of enterprise service management frameworks and standards.
* Support change management, communication, and adoption activities related to new ESM capabilities and processes.

Service Performance Management

* Support the development and reporting of service performance metrics, dashboards, and insights.
* Identify improvement opportunities to enhance service experience, operational efficiency, and process effectiveness.

Documentation & Stakeholder Engagement

* Develop and maintain service management documentation, operating procedures, process maps, requirements logs, and governance materials.
* Support preparation of presentations, reports, and materials for leadership reviews, governance forums, and stakeholder meetings.

**Qualifications**

Qualifications & Experience

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Management, or related field.
* 9+ years of experience in Knowledge Management, Business Analysis, Service Management, Project Management, or related roles within Financial Planning or shared services environments.
* Proven experience supporting Knowledge Management framework design, implementation, governance, and sustainment.
* Strong understanding of modern Knowledge Management principles, methodologies, and industry best practices.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all organizational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with reporting, analytics, and performance measurement.

title: Knowledge Editorial Lead, People Operations
description:

title: Technical Content Marketer
description:
**The Role:**

We write for researchers at frontier AI labs and for AI and ML leaders at large enterprises. They're technical readers, and they expect content that gets the details right without sounding like jargon soup.

You'll turn our research, product capabilities and customer outcomes into content these readers find useful. You'll work closely with product marketing, our research team and the founders, and you'll have room to carve a unique voice for us in the market.

**What You'll Own**

* **Distribution:**
  Every piece starts with a plan for who will see it and where. You'll map the channels before you write, adapt the piece for each one and track how it performs.
* **Long-form TOFU pieces:**
  Write blog posts, newsletters, explainers and research write-ups that make our work appeal to people evaluating AI model training and deployment.
* **BOFU content:**
  Create landing pages, one-pagers and pitch for our datasets across modalities (audio, languages, coding RL, physical AI and more), our RL environments and our agent observability suite. Write landing pages, one-pagers and product descriptions across STARK, Helix, VoxClash and our physical AI line.
* **SEO and AEO:**
  Plan content around what our buyers search for. Structure pages so search engines and AI answer engines can find and cite them.
* **Social media:**
  Plan and write content for our LinkedIn, X, and more.
* **Strategic case studies:**
  Work with customers and our sales team to write case studies that capture why each customer chose us and what it changed for them.
* **Launches and announcements:**
  Write for funding news, partnerships, product releases and conferences.

**You'll Do Well Here If You**

* **Shun AI slop:**
  You take your writing personally, and you can't stand content that reads like it came off an assembly line and recognize a technical subject is never an excuse for flat, generic content.
* **Pick up deep technical topics quickly:**
  You need curiosity and the patience to ask experts good questions until you understand the subject well enough to explain it.
* **Bring a point of view:**
  You enjoy forming opinions about the industry and backing them up in writing.
* **Obsess over quality:**
  You edit your own drafts closely and use feedback to improve the work.
* **Measure your work by results:**
  You want to know whether a piece brought in traffic, leads or conversations, and you use that to decide what to write next.
* **Use AI tools well:**
  You use LLMs for research and first drafts, and you know how to edit the output so it reads like a person wrote it.
* **Enjoy collaboration:**
  You're comfortable working with researchers, product managers, sales and design to get what a piece needs.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years in B2B content marketing, editorial, journalism or product storytelling, ideally at a dev tools SaaS/technology company.
* A portfolio of your published writing for different channels.
* Hands-on experience with SEO, and familiarity with how AI answers engines surface content.

**Bonus Points**

* You've written about AI, data or developer tools.
* You've written for formats beyond text, like video scripting or visual content.

**Why Join Us?**

* **High ownership:**
  You'll own how our story reaches the market across channels.
* **Flat hierarchy:**
  We act with urgency and clarity, and we're a small, collaborative team where good ideas move fast regardless of title.
* **A culture of learning:**
  We treat mistakes as stepping stones. There's real room to try things and get better from what didn't work.
* **Genuinely AI forward:**
  You'll have real room to experiment with AI tools in your own workflow. You'll never hear anyone tell you to stick to the old way of doing things.

title: Sr. Product Applications Engineer-DFA & DFM Support
description:
**Job Description**
Position Title:
**Sr. Product Applications Engineer-DFM& DFA Support**
Location: Hyderabad, India
  
  
Experience: 4-6yrs
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Department: Product Applications-India
  
  
**Job Summary**
Nextpower is seeking an experienced Sr. Product Applications Engineer- DFM&DFA Support to support product application engineering, production drawing verification, product testing, and manufacturing-readiness activities.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with design, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, suppliers, and field teams to ensure products are functional, manufacturable, easy to assemble, and suitable for customer and project requirements. This role requires strong experience in engineering drawing review, Design for Manufacturing, Design for Assembly, product validation, and technical issue resolution.

* Support continuous improvement and value-engineering initiatives focused on product quality, manufacturability, assembly efficiency, and cost reduction.
* Develop and improve internal DFM/DFA guidelines, drawing-review checklists, and design-verification standards.
* Collaborate closely with design engineering, manufacturing engineering, quality, sourcing, operations, project engineering, field service, and product management teams.
* Participate in customer, project, vendor, and internal engineering discussions when technical clarification is required.
* Track engineering issues, review comments, corrective actions, and technical deliverables through closure
* Work with suppliers and manufacturing teams to resolve drawing clarification, manufacturability, component quality, and production-related concerns.

* Experience with fabricated, machined, welded, sheet-metal, or assembled mechanical components.
* Hands-on experience with product testing, dimensional inspection, and measuring tools.
* Working knowledge of CAD tools such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar software.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with Jira, Arena, PLM, or similar engineering systems.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to manufacturing, supplier, customer, or project locations.
* Experience in renewable energy, solar products, structural systems, industrial equipment, automotive, aerospace, or electromechanical products will be a plus.
* Familiarity with FMEA, first-article inspection, supplier-quality processes, and engineering change management is a plus.

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
  
  
**We are Nextpower**

title: Content Lead - AI Engineering
description:
**Company Description**

byteXL is an edtech company focused on transforming engineering education in India by partnering with colleges and industry to modernize curriculum, content, and hands-on learning. The organization equips students with practical skills and clear awareness of employability requirements, enabling them to excel in evolving technology careers. By bridging the gap between academia and industry, byteXL aims to create a generation of highly skilled professionals who contribute meaningfully to national development. The company’s vision is that every engineering student has access to holistic, industry-relevant education that strengthens competencies and improves job prospects. Team members join a mission-driven environment that is deeply invested in student success and educational innovation.

**Role Summary**

As a Content Lead for AI Engineering, you'll own everything related to building applications with AI. That includes designing the curriculum, writing reading materials, building assessments, creating lab exercises, and developing projects around LLM application development, agentic workflows, RAG systems, and multi-modal AI.

This is a hands-on creation role. You'll spend most of your time building, testing, and improving content. You'll also be shipping AI applications and prototypes yourself regularly, because this space moves too fast for someone who's just reading about it. If you haven't built a RAG pipeline or debugged an agent loop yourself, you can't teach someone else to do it well.

If you're someone who's been building with LLMs since before it was cool, understands why agents fail more often than they work, and can turn a complex AI architecture into something a student can build step by step, this is your role.

**What You'll Do**

* Design semester-wise curriculum and decide how topics are structured, sequenced, and paced across the academic calendar.
* Continuously evolve the content strategy based on what's working, what's not, and where the AI engineering landscape is heading. This space changes fast and the content needs to keep up.
* Write clear, in-depth reading materials that students can actually learn from independently. Not hype-driven overviews, but grounded explanations of how things actually work under the hood.
* Design problems that test whether students understand the architecture and trade-offs behind AI applications, not just whether they can chain a few API calls together.
* Build question banks following ByteXL's quality standards for difficulty distribution, answer balance, and auto-gradability.
* Create hands-on lab exercises that take students from their first API call to building production-ready AI applications.
* Design capstone projects that push students to build complete AI applications integrating LLMs, vector stores, retrieval pipelines, and deployment.
* Build AI applications and prototypes yourself regularly to validate that what you're asking students to do is actually doable, meaningful, and teaches the right lessons.
* Stay current with how the AI engineering ecosystem is evolving.
* Try new ways of teaching and building content. If something could work better, prototype it and make the case.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

- B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.

- 3–5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, or content development with a strong focus on applied AI.

- Expert-level Python proficiency.

- Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, not just experimenting in notebooks.

- Deep understanding of prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and vector databases.

- Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows. Understands why they break and how to make them reliable.

- Working knowledge of frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.

- Experience integrating AI APIs from providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and others.

- Understanding of multi-modal AI concepts spanning text, image, and audio.

- Awareness of responsible AI principles and AI safety considerations.

- Exposure to MLOps practices for AI application deployment and monitoring.

- Can explain how a retrieval pipeline works or why an agent keeps hallucinating clearly enough that someone building their first AI app actually gets it.

- Works independently without needing constant direction.

**Nice to Have**

- Working knowledge of TypeScript for frontend integration with AI backends.

- Experience with fine-tuning and model adaptation techniques.

- Has built and open-sourced AI tools or applications.

- Background in technical training, academic teaching, or developer education.

- Active presence in the AI engineering community through blogs, talks, or open-source work.

title: Latex writer
description:
**Company Description**
Ganith Online is an educational organization founded in 2012 that invites learners into the world of mathematics through engaging exploration. The organization focuses on nurturing curiosity and discovery, helping learners experience the joy of understanding mathematical concepts. Ganith Online designs resources and experiences that make mathematics accessible, meaningful, and enjoyable for a wide range of learners. Team members collaborate to build high-quality educational materials that support both learners and educators in diverse learning environments.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time remote role for a LaTeX Writer at Ganith Online. The LaTeX Writer will be responsible for creating, formatting, and maintaining mathematics-related documents, problem sets, lesson materials, and assessments using LaTeX. Day-to-day tasks include converting handwritten or draft content into professional LaTeX documents, ensuring mathematical notation is accurate and consistent, and collaborating with educators to refine explanations and layouts for clarity. The role also involves proofreading for typographical and formatting errors, organizing content repositories, and updating materials based on feedback from the curriculum team. The LaTeX Writer will work closely with other team members via online collaboration tools to meet project timelines and uphold quality standards for educational content.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in LaTeX for mathematical typesetting, including equations, proofs, and structured documents.
* Solid foundation in mathematics (at least undergraduate-level coursework or equivalent experience) to ensure accurate representation of concepts and notation.
* Attention to detail in proofreading, formatting, and consistency across documents.
* Experience creating educational or academic materials, such as textbooks, assignments, or lecture notes, is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines for multiple projects.
* Clear written communication skills and willingness to collaborate with educators and content creators.
* Familiarity with version control or document management tools (e.g., Git, cloud-based collaboration platforms) is a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in mathematics, education, computer science, or a related field is preferred.

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Competitive Intelligence

Buyer Persona & ICP Development

Product Positioning & Value Proposition

WritingData Analysis & Interpretation

Business Writing & Structured

ReportingFamiliarity with tools like Google Trends, Statista, Crunchbase, G2, or Notion is a plus

title: Technical Manager
description:
**Position Overview**

The Technical Manager will lead technical and engineering activities for Kaprel India, ensuring accurate and timely project technical submittals, compliance with project specifications, effective coordination with contractors and consultants, and practical technical support through procurement, production and installation. The role will oversee the technical team, support product development and standardization, and act as a central technical resource for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

**Responsibilities**

**1.Technical Submittals and Project Approvals**

·        Prepare, review and coordinate complete technical submittal packages for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, in line with project-specific requirements and approval procedures.

·        Compile material submittals, compliance statements, technical data sheets, product specifications, test reports, certificates, method statements and supporting engineering documents as required.

·        Manage material and finish sample submissions, approval tracking, consultant comments, resubmissions and closure of technical queries.

·        Coordinate with main contractors, consultants, clients, project teams and Kaprel management to obtain approvals and finalize project-specific materials, system details and designs.

·        Maintain an up-to-date submittal register, document revision history and approvals record; proactively flag submission risks affecting procurement or site schedules.

**2.Technical Leadership and Engineering Management**

·        Lead and coordinate the technical and design team, assign work priorities, review deliverables and monitor workload, quality and submission deadlines.

·        Oversee the development and checking of shop drawings, fabrication drawings, installation details, material take-offs and bills of materials to support accurate procurement and manufacturing.

·        Conduct technical evaluations and design assessments for compliance with applicable standards, approved specifications, contractual scope and customer requirements.

·        Establish consistent engineering checklists, drawing review procedures, revision controls and handover requirements between departments.

·        Identify gaps or discrepancies in tender documents, drawings and specifications; raise technical clarifications and coordinate timely resolution before fabrication.

**3.Procurement, Production and Site Coordination**

·        Prepare and maintain procurement schedules and long-lead material requirements in coordination with project programmes and approved technical submittals.

·        Liaise with Procurement, Stores and Production teams to ensure the correct materials and specifications are available when required, and highlight risks early.

·        Provide technical support to manufacturing and installation teams, resolving design interfaces, fabrication constraints and site-specific technical problems.

·        Investigate installation and product performance issues, establish root causes and implement practical corrective measures to prevent recurrence.

·        Coordinate technical responses and support to customers and project teams on system specifications, installation details and product performance.

**4.Product Engineering, Quality and Improvement**

·        Drive value engineering initiatives to improve manufacturability, installation efficiency, product reliability and cost effectiveness without compromising approved performance.

·        Support new product and system development, component selection, prototyping, testing, certification and performance improvement initiatives.

·        Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders on suitable alternatives for aluminium profiles, glass, hardware, seals, gaskets and related components.

·        Maintain controlled records of technical specifications, approved system details, certificates, testing reports and product documentation for use across Kaprel locations.

·        Analyze recurring technical errors, nonconformities and rework costs; recommend design standardization and preventive improvements.

**5.Reporting and Accountability**

·        Provide regular updates to the General Manager on technical submission status, departmental workload, approval delays, unresolved technical risks and improvement initiatives.

·        Coordinate closely with regional Kaprel teams so requirements and approved technical documentation are consistent, while respecting differences in local project specifications and standards.

·        Escalate deviations involving unapproved system changes, project cost impact, contractual scope or technical performance before implementation.

**Qualifications and Experience**

·        Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical discipline.

·        Minimum 6 years of relevant construction or subcontracting experience, preferably in the glazing, architectural aluminium, partition or door systems industry.

·        Prior experience managing technical work and coordinating with main contractors, consultants and clients.

·        Good knowledge of project specifications, technical documentation, material approvals and subcontract scope management.

·        Ability to interpret engineering drawings and coordinate fabrication, procurement and installation requirements; proficiency with AutoCAD and relevant technical tools is advantageous.

·        Strong communication, organization, problem-solving and team management skills; comfortable coordinating technical deliverables across multiple locations.

For those interested, pls send your CV to recruitment@kaprel.com with subject line: Application\_Technical Manager\_India

title: Teaching and Learning Coach
company: Keystone Center for Innovation & Teacher Education
description:
**About KCITE**

KCITE works with teachers and school leaders to improve teaching and learning through professional development, research and classroom practice. Our work includes teacher education, social-emotional learning, project-based learning, digital pedagogy and school leadership.

We create learning experiences that help educators understand new ideas, try them in their classrooms and reflect on what changes.

**About the role**

We are looking for an educator who can design and develop practical courses for teachers and school leaders. You will bring together classroom experience, educational research and clear writing to create content that educators can use in their everyday work.

The role includes course development, teacher support and reviewing how effectively the learning translates into classroom practice.

**Key responsibilities**

**Course design and development**

* Identify learning needs through conversations with teachers, school leaders and the KCITE team.
* Develop course outlines with clear learning outcomes and a logical sequence of modules.
* Write course content, video scripts, facilitator guides and participant resources.
* Create classroom examples, case studies, activities and practical tools relevant to different school contexts.
* Design assessments, reflection tasks and classroom implementation assignments that show what participants have learned.

**Research and content quality**

* Use credible educational research to inform course content.
* Explain concepts in simple language while preserving their meaning and accuracy.
* Review content for relevance, clarity and suitability for the intended audience.
* Update courses based on participant feedback, classroom evidence and developments in education.

**Teacher learning and coaching**

* Facilitate workshops, course discussions and teacher learning sessions as required.
* Support teachers as they apply course ideas in their classrooms.
* Review teachers’ reflections and evidence of implementation, and provide specific, constructive feedback.
* Help teachers identify what worked, what needs improvement and what they can try next.

**Collaboration**

* Work with subject experts and the research team to develop and review content.
* Coordinate with design and technology teams to prepare courses for the KCITE platform.
* Manage agreed timelines and take responsibility for completing assigned courses and resources.

**Qualifications and experience**

* A bachelor’s degree in education or a relevant field. A postgraduate qualification in education is preferred.
* Relevant school teaching experience and a sound understanding of how children learn.
* Experience in developing curriculum, learning resources or professional development content.
* Experience in teacher training, mentoring or coaching is an advantage.

**Skills and qualities**

* Clear writing and communication skills in English.
* Ability to turn educational concepts into useful classroom examples and activities.
* Understanding of pedagogy, assessment and reflective practice.
* Ability to evaluate sources and use research responsibly.
* Comfort with digital tools for content creation and online learning.
* Attention to detail, openness to feedback and the ability to work independently.



**What success looks like**

You create well-structured, accurate courses that teachers can follow and apply. The resources address real classroom needs, and your feedback helps educators improve their practice. You complete work on time and use evidence from participants to improve the courses.

**How to apply**

Please share your CV and a sample of a course, teaching resource, training module or learning material you have developed. Include a brief note explaining your contribution to the sample and your interest in this role. Email to careers@kcite.in

title: Technical Writer
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
OUR MISSION
  
  
At Redwood Software, we unleash human potential. We empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.
  
  
**About Us**
Redwood Software is the leader in full-stack automation for mission-critical business processes. With the first SaaS-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in automation's transformative power. Our unparalleled solutions empower organizations to orchestrate, manage, and monitor their workflows across any application, service, or server — in the cloud or on-premise — with confidence and control.
  
  
CORE VALUES
  
  
One Team. One Redwood Make Your Own Weather Obsess over Customer Success Work the Problem Be Curious Own the Outcome Respect Each Other
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
  
As a Technical Writer at Redwood, you'll create and maintain documentation for our Tidal product line, working closely with product, engineering, and UX/design to keep customer-facing documentation and in-product content accurate and consistent.
  
  
You bring solid technical writing skills and sound judgment on ambiguous product or design questions. You're curious about applying AI tools to your own workflow, and comfortable partnering with designers and senior writers on content strategy. You'll follow and contribute to documentation and content design standards set by the team, and make structural or strategic content calls as they arise, looping in your lead on cross-team tradeoffs.
  
  
Documentation Development
  
  

* Write and maintain user guides, implementation documentation, developer content, and release notes for Tidal and Finance Automation, keeping pace with each release cycle.
* Produce API documentation (e.g., using Swagger/OpenAPI) for developer-facing endpoints as needed.
* Translate technical concepts — such as job scheduling and workload orchestration in Tidal, or financial close and reconciliation processes in Finance Automation — into content suited to administrators, developers, and business users.
* Keep existing documentation current as products change, verifying accuracy directly with engineering and product owners.

Content Design Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with UX/design on in-product content, UI text, tooltips, error messages, onboarding copy.
* Apply established content design principles (structure, findability, consistency) to your own documentation work.
* Identify and resolve content inconsistencies or gaps across docs and in-product text, looping in the team when a fix touches shared standards.

AI-Assisted Documentation
  
  

* Use approved AI tools to assist with drafting, editing, and structuring documentation, always reviewing AI-assisted output for accuracy before publishing.
* Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI to documentation workflows, bringing outcomes back to the team.

Documentation Publishing & Operations
  
  

* Publish and maintain documentation using the team's Git-based, docs-as-code workflow (Markdown, version control).
* Maintain metadata, organization, and versioning of published docs according to team standards.
* Update published content in response to product changes, customer feedback, and post-release review.

Team Collaboration
  
  

* Use Jira and Confluence within established team workflows.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and deliver content aligned to sprint/release cycles.
* Communicate progress, blockers, and scope changes proactively so your lead can adjust priorities and timelines.
* Collaborate with SMEs and product stakeholders to verify technical accuracy.

**Required**
YOUR EXPERIENCE
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3-5 years of technical writing experience for software products, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Experience producing user guides, API documentation, and release notes in a fast-release (Agile/sprint-based) environment.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence for project tracking and collaboration.
* Experience with Git-based, docs-as-code workflows and lightweight markup (e.g., Markdown).
* Experience applying AI tools to documentation work, whether from prior job experience or self-directed exploration.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, ability to manage multiple priorities.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).
* Experience partnering with UX/design teams on in-product content or microcopy.
* Experience with workload automation, enterprise software, or cloud-based platforms.

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

title: Senior Manager - Knowledge Management
description:
**Overview**
Role Overview
  
  
Knowledge Management (KM) is a critical enabler of Financial Planning's strategic priorities, supporting efficient and effective service delivery across PepsiCo's global operations while enhancing employee experience and operational excellence.
  
  
The FPT ESM & KM Senior Analyst plays a key role in driving the implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Knowledge Management and Enterprise Service Management (ESM) practices within the Financial Planning (FP) function. Working closely with the FP ESM & KM Lead, this role supports the deployment of KM frameworks, knowledge platforms, service management processes, service performance measurement, and service portfolio management.
  
  
As PepsiCo continues to expand its digital capabilities, including the adoption of ServiceNow and other knowledge management technologies, this role will partner with business, IT, and KM Center of Excellence (CoE) teams to ensure effective knowledge capture, governance, accessibility, and service management enablement across the global Financial Planning organization.
  
  
The role allocation is approximately:
  
  

* 80% Knowledge Management (KM)
* 20% Enterprise Service Management (ESM)

**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Knowledge Management (80%)
  
  
Knowledge Management Program Support
  
  

* Support the end-to-end Knowledge Management program, including KM framework deployment, system administration, content governance, document management, and business-critical knowledge retention.
* Partner with the FP ESM & KM Lead to drive KM best practices, governance standards, and continuous improvement initiatives across the Financial Planning organization.

Knowledge Repository Management
  
  

* Manage and maintain ServiceNow Knowledge Management content, including 4,000+ Desktop Procedures (DTPs), ensuring information remains accurate, relevant, and accessible.
* Collaborate with capability leads, sector leads, and functional teams to identify, create, update, and retire knowledge assets.
* Ensure knowledge content is structured, categorized, and aligned to capability frameworks to improve discoverability and standardization.
* Partner with the central KM team to create and maintain a centralized knowledge library for S&T teams, ensuring seamless access to trusted and up-to-date information that enhances productivity, promotes knowledge reuse, and accelerates issue resolution across the organization.
* Drive adoption of knowledge-sharing best practices across teams to improve content accessibility and knowledge reuse.

Knowledge Standardization & Adoption
  
  

* Drive content quality standards, governance processes, metadata management, and exception handling practices.
* Support the creation and maintenance of standardized knowledge taxonomies and article structures.
* Promote adoption and effective use of ServiceNow Knowledge Management, Epiplex, ARIS, and other knowledge-sharing platforms.

Knowledge Authoring & Process Documentation
  
  

* Support implementation of modern knowledge authoring methodologies and tools.
* Facilitate process knowledge capture through interactive documentation, process simulations, videos, and process maps.
* Drive adoption of ARIS for process documentation and process mapping activities.

Knowledge Retention & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Maintain knowledge lifecycle management processes, including regular review, validation, and archival activities.
* Ensure critical process knowledge is retained and updated to support workforce transitions, cross-training, and business continuity requirements.
* Monitor knowledge effectiveness metrics and recommend enhancements to optimize user experience and knowledge reuse.

Knowledge Transfer & Transition Support
  
  

* Partner with Design & Transition teams to establish and implement knowledge transfer methodologies and KM ways of working.
* Support onboarding, transition, and capability-building initiatives through structured knowledge capture and sharing practices.

Controls & Compliance
  
  

* Support KM-related controls testing activities and ensure compliance with internal control requirements, audit standards, and corporate policies.
* Drive timely remediation of observations and continuous process improvements.

Enterprise Service Management (20%)
  
  
Service Management Enablement
  
  

* Gather, analyse, document, and maintain business requirements for service management solutions across the Financial Planning organization.
* Partner with the FP ESM & KM Lead to assess, prioritize, and manage service management enhancements and initiatives.

ServiceNow Solution Support
  
  

* Support the design, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of ServiceNow-based service management solutions.
* Contribute to delivering a unified, intuitive, and employee-centric service experience across Financial Planning teams.

Backlog & Roadmap Management
  
  

* Monitor and manage service management requirements and enhancement backlogs to ensure alignment with strategic priorities.
* Support roadmap planning and future-state service management initiatives in collaboration with ESM CoE and business stakeholders.

Process Governance & Adoption
  
  

* Partner with FP service delivery teams and ESM CoE to ensure consistent implementation of enterprise service management frameworks and standards.
* Support change management, communication, and adoption activities related to new ESM capabilities and processes.

Service Performance Management
  
  

* Support the development and reporting of service performance metrics, dashboards, and insights.
* Identify improvement opportunities to enhance service experience, operational efficiency, and process effectiveness.

Documentation & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Develop and maintain service management documentation, operating procedures, process maps, requirements logs, and governance materials.
* Support preparation of presentations, reports, and materials for leadership reviews, governance forums, and stakeholder meetings.

**Qualifications**
Qualifications & Experience
  
  
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Management, or related field.
* 9+ years of experience in Knowledge Management, Business Analysis, Service Management, Project Management, or related roles within Financial Planning or shared services environments.
* Proven experience supporting Knowledge Management framework design, implementation, governance, and sustainment.
* Strong understanding of modern Knowledge Management principles, methodologies, and industry best practices.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all organizational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with reporting, analytics, and performance measurement.

title: Professional, Integrations
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
As an Integration Support Professional at Accurate, you will drive Accurate's future growth engine by assisting Accurate’s Onboarding Team and clients through the onboarding/integration process and turning them into happy users. Additionally, you will collaborate with multiple internal departments to ensure clients and Accurate are positioned for short and long term success.
  
  
A full degree of creativity and latitude are expected in this role to facilitate delivery of results to our business. Being consultative and solutions-oriented are critical for this position.
  
  
**This Role Is For You If**

* You have an in-depth understanding of integrated solutions using different methods of communication (i.e., API’s, periodic files, etc.).
* You have worked with cross-functional teams to problem solve and provide ideal solutions to achieve client objectives.
* You thrive on the urgency and importance of working with our clients and are capable of independently triaging reported issues/bugs related to their integrated solution and leading the effort to resolve.
* You want to actively increase a client’s overall satisfaction with their integrated solution and help Accurate understand the benefits of client requested changes/improvements.
* You have the passion and drive to change the job applicant/candidate and recruiter experience for the better.
* You can engage in business-level and technical conversations with internal and external clients.

At Accurate, we're transforming the background screening experience through innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to client success. As a fast-growing organization, we partner with leading employers to deliver seamless screening and credentialing solutions that help build safer, more trusted workplaces. We foster a collaborative, results-driven culture where new ideas are welcomed, learning is encouraged, and career growth opportunities are plentiful. If you're looking to make an impact while working alongside a talented team in a dynamic environment, Accurate could be the place for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you will triage client reported issues in relation to their ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or API integrations. Additionally, you will assist clients and the Accurate Onboarding Team in integration configuration and testing, as well as answer open client questions in relation to integrations, provide clarification on solutions, etc.
  
  

* Act as an initial point of contact for all client reported integration issues or concerns through ticketing system.
* Troubleshoot complex data flow issues between Accurate and third-party ATS, HRIS, and recruiting platforms.
* Analyze API requests, responses, error logs, and webhook deliveries to identify root causes of integration issues and either offer potential solutions OR escalate accordingly.
* Maintain communication with stakeholders regarding resolution of reported issues.
* Understand client integration requirements and system capabilities and be able to translate accordingly.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for platform-specific integration capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
* Work closely with clients and ATS representatives to identify account setup and integration requirements.
* Work closely with Onboarding to properly configure clients for specific integrations, considering any client specific initiatives/requirements.
* Provide support for integration testing.
* Translate technical concepts into business-friendly language for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* A familiarity with integrated API solutions and ability to explain technical solutions to clients.
* Ability to understand, evaluate, and translate complex client requirements into practical integration solutions.
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills combined with a commitment and proven ability to succeed within a fast-paced organization.
* Strong overall interpersonal skills and a history exceeding client expectations.
* Time-management skills and the ability to establish reasonable and attainable deadlines for resolution.
* Self-motivated professional with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
* Basic knowledge of XML and JSON required.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and databases required.
* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Experience with related tools such as Postman, SOAP UI, etc., a plus.
* Background Screening experience a plus.

**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
  
  
You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
  
  
**Special Notice**
Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.

title: Specialist - Data Engineering
description:

This role is an excellent opportunity to launch or advance a career in enterprise business intelligence, data analysis, and application automation. You will gain practical experience building Power BI and Tableau reporting solutions while developing skills in Power Apps, Power Automate, data modeling, and SQL.

Working alongside experienced developers and engineers, you will learn how business needs are translated into trusted data products and efficient digital workflows. Key Responsibilities
  
  
Support in the development and maintenance of Power BI reports, Tableau dashboards, Power Apps applications, and Power Automate workflows.
  
  
Analyze data using SQL to validate requirements, investigate discrepancies, identify trends, and support report development.
  
  
Develop SQL queries, calculated fields, report visuals, application components, and workflow steps under the guidance of senior team members.
  
  
Execute documented unit tests, data-reconciliation procedures, defect corrections, deployment steps, and routine production-support activities.
  
  
Manage assigned tasks by following development standards, maintaining documentation, communicating progress, and escalating blockers promptly.
  
  
Collaborate and learn through design sessions, code reviews, technical training, knowledge-sharing activities, and feedback from experienced engineers.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Exposure to DAX (Power BI) or advanced Tableau calculated-field logic beyond the basics.
  
  
Familiarity with cloud data warehouses/platforms (e.g., Google BigQuery, Snowflake, SQL Server).
  
  
Exposure to data-prep/ETL tools such as Power Query or Alteryx.
  
  
Experience participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies using Jira and Confluence.
  
  
Basic understanding of data governance and security concepts (e.g., row-level security, access controls).
  
  
Exposure to connecting Power Automate flows with Power Apps and other Microsoft 365 services.
  
  
Coursework or certification in Power BI, Tableau, or SQL (e.g., Microsoft PL-300).
  
  
Interest in or exposure to BI modernization/migration efforts such as Tableau-to-Power BI conversion.
  
  
What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

title: Specialist, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (Health Care Sector) - Mumbai/Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist – Health Care Sector Research – Center for Health Solutions – Research & Insights**
The Deloitte Center for Health Solutions is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (MI&I) group, focusing primarily on the Life Sciences & Health Care industry. The Center's goals are:
  
  

* Deloitte Center for Health Solutions (DCHS) is Deloitte’s trusted source for actionable insights on the most pressing issues in life sciences and health care.
* Our mission is to turn evidence into influence—delivering research that challenges conventional wisdom, sparks dialogue and drives transformation across the health ecosystem.
* The Center brings together researchers, policy experts, and strategists to generate differentiated, data-driven thought leadership.
* As part of Deloitte’s Research & Insights organization within the Clients, Strategy and Growth function, DCHS works at the intersection of commercial, public sector, academic, and business to help our clients, and the world, make smarter, more sustainable decisions about health.

Learn more about the Center and have a peek into our work here – Deloitte Center for Health Solutions .
  
  
This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the health care sector across health providers and health insurers subsectors. Our Center focuses on key topics and campaigns including AI and tech-enabled transformation, care model transformation, workforce productivity, consumer engagement, and more.
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in the health care sector, with a focus on health providers and health insurers subsectors that include topics like affordability and cost of care, AI and tech-enabled transformation, care delivery transformation, patient experience and engagement, strategic margin growth, M&A and strategic partnerships, and the US regulatory and policy landscape (340B changes, Medicaid reform, Medicare rate updates, price transparency, AI-governance etc.). These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse health care sector topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.
* Identify and apply relevant analytical methods, partnering with data science and analytics professionals to derive actionable insights from large, complex datasets (Capital IQ, Pitchbook, Alphasense, Mergermarket, FDA, CMS datasets, O\*NET, KFF, public company filings) in support of health care research and business priorities.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Support all aspects of engagement/project to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings.

**Experience**
**Requisite experience and skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects in health care topic areas.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.

**Industry/sector/subsector Skills**

* Business research/thought leadership development experience in the health care sector is preferred.
* Knowledge of U.S. health care sector, including key trends across providers, insurers, related health care segments, as well as impact of policy, and regulatory forces on the industry, is preferred.
* Familiarity with the impact of AI, advanced analytics, and other emerging technologies on health care business models, operations, workforce, care delivery will be an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research.
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights.
* Ability to use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze large and complex datasets, including surveys.
* Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills. Journalistic and narrative writing style is preferred, along with prior experience in report writing and research report development.
* Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights.
* Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.
* Ability to understand the impact of marketplace changes on the industry, sector, or sub-sector.
* Proficiency in using generative AI-based platforms and tools to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing.
* Proficiency in using generative AI and related tools to identify early signals and trends shaping the market through continuous sensing will be preferred.
* Familiarity with building custom GPTs and custom gen-AI research tools will be an added advantage.

**The broader Deloitte Research and Insights team**
The Deloitte Research and Insights teams’ mission is to conduct research and analysis to develop compelling, forward-looking perspectives that enable clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The team plays an integral role in strengthening the firm’s strategic positioning by developing high-quality thoughtware from end to end, published on Deloitte Insights and Deloitte.com.
  
  
Their work includes:
  
  

* Managing relations with internal stakeholders.
* Using advanced data science and survey advisory capabilities to strengthen the credibility of insights.
* Using editorial and visualization capabilities to improve the stickiness of firm thoughtware.

**Qualifications, experience, work location, and timing**
Academic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA, PGDM, Economics, Business Economics
  
  
Work experience: 3-6 years
  
  
Location: Hyderabad/Mumbai
  
  
Work hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Medical Writer I / Medical Writer II
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose - moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking Medical Writer I or II, Patient Safety to join our team in a
**hybrid / on-site / remote**
capacity. As a Medical Writer I or II, Patient Safety, you will support critical pharmacovigilance and safety activities that advance new treatments for patients and ensure regulatory compliance. This position plays a key role in developing regulatory safety documents, managing safety signals, and maintaining the highest standards of scientific accuracy and compliance. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to safety operations from product conception through lifecycle management.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through developing compelling safety narratives, conducting rigorous signal detection, and ensuring regulatory excellence. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, Medical Writer I or II can explore career paths and expand skills across pharmacovigilance and medical writing.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Prepare, compile, and lead development of scheduled and ad-hoc aggregate safety reports including Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs), Periodic Benefit Risk Evaluation Reports (PBRERs), Development Safety Update Reports (DSURs), and other regulatory safety documents, ensuring accuracy and timely submission across multiple regions
* Conduct independent signal detection activities by collecting and analyzing safety data from multiple sources including databases, clinical data, literature, and regulatory websites, applying both quantitative and qualitative methodologies to identify potential safety signals
* Prepare comprehensive signal assessment documents such as Drug Safety Reports (DSRs) and Signal Evaluation Reports (SERs), synthesizing data from various sources and providing clear, evidence-based conclusions
* Conduct systematic literature searches and reviews to summarize safety data, identify emerging safety trends, and support signal evaluation and epidemiology assessments
* Manage signal tracking activities, maintain comprehensive signal logs, identify and resolve data discrepancies in safety data sources, and ensure data integrity across all deliverables
* Assist in preparing and updating Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and related documents, ensuring alignment with safety data and regulatory requirements across therapeutic areas
* Manage client interactions effectively, handle routine queries independently, escalate complex issues appropriately, and deliver proactive status updates while adapting to client-specific requirements
* Maintain audit-ready documentation, ensure proper archiving of source materials, and support inspection readiness activities to ensure regulatory compliance
* For Medical Writer II positions: Mentor junior team members on technical and soft skills, provide constructive feedback, lead complex client discussions, manage multi-stakeholder document review cycles, and contribute to process improvement initiatives

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in analytical thinking, scientific writing, and problem-solving to interpret complex safety data and draw meaningful conclusions
* Experience working in pharmacovigilance, healthcare, or a regulated environment with understanding of global regulatory requirements
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly with both internal stakeholders and external clients
* A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to producing high-quality, compliant deliverables
* Comfort working with medical writing tools, MS Office applications, and pharmacovigilance databases and coding dictionaries (MedDRA, WHO-DD)

**Required Qualifications**

* University degree in Life Sciences, Health, or Biomedical Sciences (such as Pharmacy, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biophysics, Dentistry, or Physiotherapy) or equivalent combination of training and work experience
* 2+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance, medical writing, or related field (Medical Writer I); 4+ years of experience (Medical Writer II)
* Solid understanding of global pharmacovigilance regulations, medical terminology, and safety-related concepts
* Proficiency in medical writing tools and MS Office applications with familiarity in pharmacovigilance databases and coding dictionaries
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills with excellent time management and ability to prioritize multiple concurrent projects

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in pharmacovigilance or related safety assessment fields
* Clinical exposure in hospital-based environments or direct clinical research experience
* Expertise in specific therapeutic areas or product types
* Familiarity with pharmacovigilance systems and regulatory submission processes across multiple regions

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

description:
TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
This position is an intermediate level position in which the Quality Engineer is expected to be able to complete work with increasing independence. A Project Quality Engineer in Subsea Projects Quality North America is a critical player in ensuring proper planning and execution a Subsea project to our customers. Their responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Supporting the tender phase to establish customer quality requirements.
* Providing Quality support / guidance to project / site team throughout the project lifecycle
* Promoting a Quality culture on the project/ site, ensuring implementation of best practices and continuous improvement of quality standards and systems
* Facilitating RCA/CARs to ensure completeness and adequacy of controls

Perform Client Satisfaction Surveys and follow up on results
  
  
**Job Description**

* Supports the establishment of customer quality requirements during the tender phase
* Leads the development and approval of Quality Plans and Inspection and Test Plans
* Reviews the accuracy and availability of all Quality related documentation
* Analyzes lessons learned and applies learnings as applicable
* Provides Quality support / guidance to project / site team throughout the project lifecycle
* Leads Project audits / reviews and is responsible for follow-up
* Proactively identifies problems and drives solutions through implementation and sustainment
* Verifies the effectiveness of existing and newly implemented systems for improvement or compliance
* Participates actively in the risk assessment workshops on the project
* Promotes a Quality culture on the project/ site, ensuring implementation of best practices and continuous improvement of quality standards and systems
* Collaborates with Suppliers and Supplier Quality to ensure project requirements are met
* Leads and facilitates RCA/CARs to ensure completeness and adequacy of controls
* Monitors, reports, analyses KPIs to ensure compliance, performance visibility, and actions for improvement
* Compiles and analyzes complex quality data, identifies trends / causes and proposes corrective actions
* Implements an effective corrective and preventive action system and tracks closure of NCRs
* Resolves operational issues related to customer third party representatives
* Configures and updates the QMS (Quality Management System) and contributes to its continuous improvement
* Recommends training for employees
* Reports progress and handles inquiries and issues with the Client quality representatives
* Assists in the definition of project objectives and metrics (KPI), analyzes performance, proposes corrective actions

**You Are Meant For This Job If**

* Bachelor's degree preferably with a specialization in Quality (Engineering degree for Quality Engineer only, equivalent qualification for Quality Analyst)
* Minimum 2 years of experience in oil and gas field
* Good understanding and knowledge of all main procedures and Management systems
* Some project management skills
* Presentation and some coaching skills
* Ability to work in a team-oriented environment
* Capable of producing standard quality documents
* Knowledgeable in how changes influence project cost
* Capable of leading internal meetings

English
  
  
Customer Relationship Management
