title: Associate - Market Research and Insights
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Associate, Market Research and Insights**
Do you like working with people associated with an organization that enables flow of knowledge and expertise to our client service professionals around the world? Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you. We are looking for highly motivated individuals with expertise in communications, attention to detail, positive attitude, presence, and ability to interact across many levels to support delivery of projects with Deloitte member firms around the world.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an Associate, Market Research and Insights in the team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Conduct internal and external research to identify topic trends, support collection scope decisions, and develop insights using internal portals and third-party research sources.
* Support content curation and repository management by organizing, tagging, publishing, updating, and maintaining content in accordance with approved taxonomy, metadata, governance, and workflow standards.
* Analyze content usage, freshness, gaps, and search performance to support archival, acquisition, and promotion recommendations for collection priorities.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, process documentation, and training materials to support project coordination and operational improvement.
* Collaborate across knowledge-sharing channels, communities of practice, and stakeholder groups to support high-quality content delivery and continuous process improvement.

**The team**
The team enables Deloitte professionals to access and apply the firm’s global knowledge, capabilities, and expertise in service of clients. Through Knowledge Exchange (KX), Deloitte’s authoritative knowledge destination, the team curates, publishes, and maintains content across key business and industry topics, helping practitioners quickly find relevant knowledge and connect with subject-matter experts. We also manage repositories and knowledge platforms, acquire proposals and client deliverables, and collaborates with Knowledge Services, Knowledge Managers, subject-matter experts, and business stakeholders to prioritize and publish high-quality content across Deloitte.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, Bangalore
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Postgraduate degree or Master of Business Administration with 1+ year of experience, or bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of experience
* Degree in Business Administration, English, Mass Communication, Humanities, Library Science, Commerce, Information Systems, or a similar field
* Experience conducting secondary research using internal and external research sources
* Experience supporting content management, content curation, or repository management activities
* Experience using taxonomy, metadata, search, or content lifecycle processes
* Experience creating reports, dashboards, presentations, or process documentation using Microsoft Office applications
* Experience using GenAI tools to support research, content, or process improvement activities

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Factiva, Hoovers, OneSource, Thomson, or similar research databases
* Experience supporting intranet portals, collaboration platforms, or knowledge repositories
* Experience with search engine optimization, metrics reporting, or content usage analysis
* Experience with SharePoint, Tableau, Photoshop, or intranet social media tools

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

6+ Years

Hyderabad

title: Associate Workday HRIS – Workday Absence & Payroll
description:
**Our Company**
As a part of Brookfield’s $416B credit platform, Oaktree is a premier credit manager emphasizing an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investing across credit, equity, and real estate.
  
  
Oaktree is committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture.
  
  
Oaktree is wholly owned by Brookfield, a leading global investment firm with more than $1 trillion in assets under management. Brookfield owns and operates high-quality businesses and real assets that provide essential services and form the backbone of the global economy. It invests on behalf of institutions and individuals around the world across infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity, real estate, and credit.
  
  
For additional information, please visit Oaktree’s website at http://www.oaktreecapital.com/
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Associate, HRIS – Workday Absence & Payroll is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and continuously improving HR systems and operational processes across the organization. This role serves as a strategic thought partner to HR customer groups, translating business requirements into effective Workday solutions, advising on process and data needs, and supporting informed business decision-making.
  
  
The position will collaborate closely with the Human Resources Systems (HRS) team, senior global HR leadership, HR Service Operations, and senior business stakeholders across the Brookfield-supported footprint.
  
  
This position requires the employee to work onsite.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide functional and technical expertise in Workday Absence, Payroll, and HCM Core, with a focus on delivering scalable and efficient HR solutions.
* Design, configure, and maintain complex Workday Absence and Payroll functionality, including accruals, time-off plans, eligibility rules, payroll-related configuration, and related business processes.
* Translate business requirements into detailed and effective Workday system configurations, ensuring alignment with HR policies and business objectives.
* Develop and maintain Business Process Definitions, condition rules, approval workflows, notifications, and other Workday business process configurations.
* Configure and support Workday Payroll functionality, including payroll processes, earnings and deductions, payroll inputs, pay components and related business processes in accordance with business requirements.
* Partner with Payroll, HR, Finance, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot payroll issues, assess impacts, and support timely resolution of production issues and payroll-related requests.
* Configure leave types, absence eligibility, entitlement units, accruals, accrual defaulting, and time-off plans in accordance with business policies and requirements.
* Develop and maintain calculated fields and leverage Workday configuration capabilities to support complex business requirements.
* Manage areas such as leave type/segment security, time-off transfer balance units, alert messages, worklets, delegation, custom notifications, and Workday surveys.
* Prepare detailed test plans and test cases, conduct manual testing, and support regression and release testing for Workday updates and enhancements.
* Lead testing, data validation, defect identification, and resolution activities during system releases and process changes.
* Analyze large HR data loads and validate data accuracy, completeness, and integrity during data transfers and system updates.
* Collaborate with business users and HR stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements, system enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
* Provide guidance and training to the HR Service Operations team on Workday functionality, business processes, and best practices, leveraging Workday Community and other supported resources.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and provide consultative support on Workday Absence and Payroll issues and complex business requirements.
* Support and maintain integrations and data interfaces, including an understanding of Enterprise Interface Builder (EIBs) and related Workday integration concepts.
* Maintain system and data integrity and ensure Workday solutions and processes continue to support business objectives.
* Train, mentor, and coach team members, sharing Workday knowledge and best practices to build team capability.
* Work effectively in a global environment and collaborate across multiple teams, stakeholders, time zones, and competing priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Hands-on experience supporting Workday Absence and Payroll configuration and payroll processes is required.
* Workday Time Tracking experience is nice to have for this role.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Workday Absence and Payroll, with strong experience in Workday HCM Core.
* Strong technical and functional expertise in Workday Absence and Payroll configuration.
* Strong understanding of HR policies and the ability to translate policy requirements into Workday configuration.
* Experience developing test plans, test cases, and conducting manual testing, including testing associated with Workday releases.
* Experience analyzing and validating large HR data loads to ensure accurate and complete data transfer.
* Working knowledge of EIBs, integrations, calculated fields, and Workday configuration tools.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
* Demonstrated ability to train, mentor, and coach team members.

**Role Overview:**

QualiZeal is looking for a
**Content Writer – Demand Generation**
to work closely with our Demand Generation, Sales, Marketing, and SME teams.

This role is focused on creating
**short, compelling and business-focused content that helps generate conversations with prospects and supports pipeline creation**
.

Unlike a traditional content marketing role, this position will primarily focus on
**outbound campaigns, prospecting communication, account-based messaging and sales enablement content**
.

The ideal candidate should understand how to convert complex technology and business topics into
**simple, relevant and personalized messages for senior decision-makers such as CIOs, CTOs, VPs, Directors and Quality Engineering leaders.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Demand Generation Campaigns:**
  Create high-quality email campaigns, follow-up sequences, LinkedIn messages, InMails and other prospecting content for outbound Demand Generation programs.
* **Account-Based Messaging:**
  Develop personalized messaging for specific accounts, industries, personas and business situations as part of ABM and strategic account campaigns.
* **Industry & Persona Messaging:**
  Create messaging for different industries such as Banking, Insurance, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Retail, Technology, Travel, Hospitality, Media and other enterprise segments.
* **Executive-Level Content:**
  Write concise and relevant outreach for CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, VPs, Directors and other senior technology and business leaders.
* **Business Problem-Based Messaging:**
  Understand the challenges faced by prospects and develop messaging around their business problems, rather than simply describing QualiZeal's services.
* **Follow-up Sequences:**
  Build structured multi-touch campaigns with strong openings, relevant problem statements, clear business value and simple CTAs.
* **Sales Enablement:**
  Create prospect-specific emails, meeting follow-ups, event outreach, capability introductions, campaign briefs, talking points and other content required by Demand Generation and Sales teams.
* **Event Campaigns:**
  Develop pre-event, during-event and post-event outreach for conferences, roundtables, webinars and executive events.
* **AI & Quality Engineering Content:**
  Work with internal SMEs to understand Quality Engineering, AI-led QE, GenAI Validation, Data Testing, Automation, Performance Engineering, Security Testing and other capabilities, and convert them into easy-to-understand prospect messaging.
* **Research & Personalization:**
  Research companies, industries, personas, technology trends and business signals to make campaigns more relevant and account-specific.
* **Content Optimization:**
  Review campaign responses and engagement with the DG team and continuously improve subject lines, messaging, CTAs and follow-up approaches.
* **AI-Assisted Content Creation:**
  Effectively use Generative AI and other AI tools for research, personalization, campaign ideation and content development while maintaining quality and accuracy.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* **4+ years of experience**
  in B2B content writing, preferably in IT services, SaaS, technology, consulting or enterprise services.
* Strong experience writing
  **email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, sales messaging or Demand Generation content**
  .
* Excellent command of written English with the ability to write in
  **simple, conversational US English**
  .
* Ability to write short and impactful content rather than long, generic marketing copy.
* Good understanding of
  **B2B buyers and enterprise decision-makers**
  .
* Ability to understand technical topics and translate them into
  **business value**
  .
* Strong research skills and ability to personalize content by
  **company, industry, persona and business challenge**
  .
* Comfortable working closely with Demand Generation executives, Sales teams and technical SMEs.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and quick turnaround requirements.
* Experience using
  **Generative AI/LLMs for content and research**
  is highly preferred.
* Knowledge of Quality Engineering, Software Testing, AI, Data Engineering or Digital Transformation would be an advantage.

**Key Skills:**

**B2B Content Writing | Demand Generation | Email Campaigns | LinkedIn Outreach | ABM Messaging | Sales Enablement | Copywriting | Prospect Research | Personalization | GenAI/LLMs | Technology Content**

**About QualiZeal:**

QualiZeal, headquartered in Texas, USA, is a leading provider of AI-powered Quality Engineering services worldwide. We work with global enterprises across industries, helping them improve software quality, accelerate digital transformation, and adopt AI-led Quality Engineering.

With 1000+ professionals and 70+ global enterprise clients, QualiZeal is a fast-growing organization with a strong presence across North America, India, and other global markets.

**Why Join QualiZeal:**

* Work directly with a global Demand Generation organization.
* Create content that has a direct connection to
  **prospect engagement, pipeline and revenue**
  .
* Gain exposure to AI, Quality Engineering and enterprise technology.
* Work across multiple industries, geographies and senior buyer personas.
* Opportunity to experiment with
  **AI-led Demand Generation and personalized GTM strategies**
  .
* Strong career growth opportunities within a fast-growing organization.

title: SAP EWM/TMS Master Data Specialist
description:
**Recommended experience**

* 7-10 years of total SAP functional / techno-functional experience.
* At least 4-6 years focused on SAP master data, EWM, TMS, BP / CVI, IDoc / DRF replication, and production support.
* Strong preference for candidates who have supported cutover, go-live, and hypercare in a multi-system SAP landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and troubleshoot master-data replication and synchronization across SAP systems, including materials, customers, vendors, and Business Partners.
* Support SAP Business Partner, CVI, and DRF-related issues, including replication failures and master-data inconsistencies.
* Maintain and troubleshoot EWM material and warehouse master data, including warehouse/product attributes, plant extensions, UOM, serial profiles, and packaging data.
* Investigate and resolve data-quality issues related to gross/net weight, packaging, dimensions, shipping addresses, and transportation attributes.
* Troubleshoot SAP IDoc errors and integration issues affecting master-data replication and warehouse operations.
* Support shipping and transportation master data, including ship-to details, loading groups, and transportation groups.
* Perform master-data validation, reconciliation, and remediation to ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems.
* Support warehouse deployments, cutover activities, and go-live readiness for new sites and 3PL operations.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and defects using ServiceNow and JIRA, including root-cause analysis and documentation.
* Collaborate with business, functional, and technical teams to resolve recurring issues and implement preventive measures.

**Required qualifications**

* Strong experience in SAP master data processes for customer, vendor, BP, material, batch, serial, and equipment-related domains.
* Hands-on experience with SAP EWM and good working knowledge of warehouse-specific product / material setup, inbound delivery, outbound delivery, and warehouse execution processes.
* Working knowledge of SAP TMS-related master data and cross-functional dependencies with logistics and shipping processes.
* Experience with CVI, BP integration, DRF, ALE / IDoc processing, and cross-system replication troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze master-data defects across ECC, EWM, TMS, and connected systems, including data dependencies between MM, IM, deliveries, batch, serial, and equipment flows.
* Strong understanding of MM / IM concepts, packaging data, weight / dimension data, units of measure, serial management, equipment handling, batch management, and warehouse-specific product controls.
* Experience working on production support queues with incident triage, root-cause analysis, and turnaround expectations.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work directly with business users during urgent cutover or go-live windows.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in SAP S/4 transformation or enterprise migration programs.
* Knowledge of transportation or shipping master data issues, including destination address, partner data, and downstream shipping-system dependencies.
* Experience with packaging master-data maintenance, warehouse extensions, serial-profile corrections, and unit-of-measure setup.
* Ability to write functional specifications and coordinate with ABAP, middleware, and integration teams for enhancements.

**Education requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master's degree or MBA is preferred but not required.
* SAP certification in MM, EWM, S/4HANA, or related logistics / integration areas is a plus.

title: Curriculum Operations Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Curriculum Operations Senior Associate**
Position Summary
  
  
The Curriculum Operations Senior Associate (India) works as part of the Audit Learning Strategy team, and closely with the Learning Design team, business unit subject matter experts, and other Development & Performance team members to support the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Audit learning curriculum.
  
  
This individual serves as a key operational partner responsible for executing curriculum management processes, coordinating learning asset updates, and ensuring learning content remains current, compliant, and accessible. The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, project coordination capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across a large and complex curriculum portfolio.
  
  
The Curriculum Operations Senior Associate plays a critical role in supporting Audit learning initiatives by managing curriculum and learning design lifecycle activities, coordinating annual content reviews, maintaining learning assets, supporting live learning programs, and ensuring compliance with firm and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Learning Design Lifecycle
  
  

* Partner directly with the design team to manage eLearning lifecycle activities, monitoring progress against established timelines and ensuring work advances in alignment with the team’s priorities.
* Maintain tracking tools to ensure eLearning portfolio and pipeline remain current and aligned with business priorities.
* Execute recurring curriculum management processes, including coordinating course updates, deactivations, closedowns, conversions, and archive activities.
* Coordinate annual review activities by initiating review cycles, tracking progress, communicating with subject matter experts, and documenting required changes.
* Validate course updates, assessments, answer keys, and supporting materials prior to publication.
* Manage eLearning session uploads and updates within learning systems and associated platforms.
* Support the administration of non-CPE learning content, including recording management, SCORM conversions, and learning playlists.
* Ensure curriculum materials are accurate, accessible, organized, and aligned with established standards.

Compliance Assurance
  
  

* Ensure compliance with and documentation of NASBA, AICPA, and internal Crowe standards.
* Coordinate technical reviews and required approvals with subject matter experts and stakeholders.
* Conduct compliance quality assurance reviews of learning materials, review and final exam questions, and supporting resources.
* Maintain documentation supporting compliance and curriculum governance processes.

Learning Program Support
  
  

* Maintain and update participant-facing materials, including agendas, surveys, and resource pages.
* Maintain and update SharePoint sites and learning resource repositories.
* Support Audit learning program preparation and post-event activities.
* Conduct testing and support quality reviews of learning sites, course environments, and learner experiences.
* Coordinate with learning delivery, design, and technology teams to support successful program execution.

Project Coordination and Operational Support
  
  

* Coordinate curriculum management activities across multiple concurrent projects and initiatives.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, and action plans.
* Partner with internal learning teams, external vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Escalate risks, delays, or issues that may impact project timelines or learner experience.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to streamline curriculum management processes and improve operational efficiency.

Stakeholder Communication and Collaboration
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with Audit subject matter experts.
* Communicate eLearning project status, upcoming deadlines, review requirements, and curriculum updates to stakeholders.
* Coordinate with learning strategy, design, technology, and program delivery teams to support curriculum initiatives.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong curriculum management and learning operations experience.
* Excellent organizational and project coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience maintaining complex learning portfolios and curriculum records.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across global teams.
* Ability to support learning projects and assets with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to develop and edit content according to specific clients’ needs.
* Commitment to process improvement and operational excellence.
* Working knowledge of instructional design principles and eLearning technologies, such as Articulate 360, and an interest in expanding hands-on design and development capabilities.
* Proficiency in using project management tools, such as Microsoft Office applications and SharePoint, to track and communicate project status, issues, and risk.
* Experience with SharePoint and Microsoft Office applications, from design, formatting, and functionality lens to create elevated learner experiences.

**General Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in learning and development, curriculum administration, learning operations, program coordination, or related fields.
* Experience supporting large-scale learning curricula, eLearning or learning programs.
* Experience with the practical application of instructional design and adult learning theory to help guide and support our design team to deliver visually compelling solutions and provide a rewarding experience for the learner.
* Experience working in a professional services environment preferred.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and managing multiple stakeholders.
* Experience with Microsoft Office applications, SharePoint, project management tools, and learning technologies.

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
← Back to careers
  
  
Founder's Office
  
  
Founder's Office Intern
  
  
Location Anywhere in India (IST / similar timezone)
  
  
Experience Final-year student or recent graduate; prior internship or project ownership preferred
  
  
Employment Internship (3–6 months)
  
  
Compensation Competitive stipend
  
  
Reporting to Founders
  
  
**About The Role**
Qonfido is building an AI companion for money, helping people organise, understand, and grow their wealth with clarity and confidence.
  
  
As a Founder's Office Intern, you will sit at the centre of the company: close to strategy, product, data, and day-to-day execution. This is not a shadowing internship. You will own real workstreams, present recommendations to founders, and help turn ambiguity into decisions and decisions into shipped outcomes.
  
  
You will move across strategy setting, data analysis, product management support, AI optimisation, and operational follow-through, learning how a modern fintech startup actually runs.
  
  
If you are curious, structured, comfortable with AI tools, and energised by solving messy problems end to end, this role is for you.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
Strategy & Problem Framing
  
  

* Help founders frame weekly and monthly priorities: what matters, why now, and what success looks like.
* Turn open-ended questions into crisp problem statements, options, and recommendation memos.
* Support competitive, market, and customer research that informs product and growth bets.
* Track strategic initiatives from idea → decision → owner → next milestone.

Data Analysis & Insights
  
  

* Pull, clean, and analyse product, growth, and operational data to answer founder questions quickly.
* Build lightweight dashboards, scorecards, and recurring insight notes (what changed, why it matters, what to do).
* Validate hypotheses with evidence (not vibes) and flag risks, anomalies, and opportunities early.
* Translate analysis into clear visuals and one-page briefs founders can act on.

Product Management Support
  
  

* Support discovery: user interviews, feedback synthesis, journey mapping, and opportunity sizing.
* Help write PRDs, specs, acceptance criteria, and release checklists for priority initiatives.
* Coordinate across design, engineering, and go-to-market to keep scope, timelines, and dependencies visible.
* Run QA / dogfooding passes, document bugs/edge cases, and close the loop after launches.

AI Optimisation & Workflow Design
  
  

* Identify repetitive Founder Office and team workflows that AI can compress or improve.
* Design and document prompts, agents, and SOPs for research, writing, analysis, QA, and reporting.
* Experiment with tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Notion AI, spreadsheet copilots) and measure time saved / quality lift.
* Help the team adopt better AI habits: templates, evaluation checklists, and versioned workflows.

Operational Support
  
  

* Own follow-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, and decision logs so nothing important falls through.
* Coordinate cross-functional projects: timelines, owners, blockers, and weekly status updates.
* Support special projects spanning hiring ops, partner outreach, content briefs, or launch readiness as needed.
* Create durable systems (docs, trackers, checklists) that make the company faster after you leave each workstream.

What success looks like
  
  
Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:
  
  

* Deliver founder-ready memos and analyses that lead to clear decisions.
* Own at least one end-to-end workstream from problem framing to measurable outcome.
* Ship useful AI workflows that reduce cycle time for recurring Founder Office tasks.
* Keep priorities, owners, and next actions visible across the initiatives you support.
* Demonstrate strong judgment: escalate early, communicate crisply, and improve with feedback.

Who you are
  
  

* Final-year undergraduate / postgraduate student or recent graduate (any rigorous major; preference for business, economics, CS, design, or quantitative fields).
* Strong analytical and written communication skills. You can turn complexity into clarity.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and basic data analysis; SQL / Python / BI tools are a plus.
* Hands-on with modern AI tools and eager to invent better ways of working.
* Structured operator: you track details, close loops, and hate dropped balls.
* High ownership and bias to action in ambiguous environments.
* Available full-time (or near full-time) for 3–6 months; based anywhere in India (IST or a similar timezone).

Bonus points
  
  

* Prior internship in startups, consulting, product, analytics, or strategy.
* Personal projects, campus clubs, or research where you owned outcomes, not just tasks.
* Experience writing specs, running user interviews, or shipping a small product/feature.
* Fintech, consumer apps, or personal-finance curiosity.
* Design fluency (Figma/Canva) or light engineering fluency.

Why join us
  
  
You will work directly with founders at an early-stage fintech building AI-native money products: rare exposure for an internship.
  
  
You will learn how strategy, product, data, and operations connect in practice, not in a textbook.
  
  
High performers will leave with a portfolio of real decisions influenced, workflows built, and outcomes shipped, and a strong path to a full-time conversation if there is mutual fit.

description:

**Gurugram, Haryana, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in online advertising in a customer-facing role using Google Ads, the Google Ads product suite, YouTube, or other online advertising systems.
* Experience using insights from data to influence business decisions.
* Experience in project management, including initiating workstreams, developing project plans, and fostering cross-organizational collaboration.

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
  
  
In this role, you will have deep product knowledge, provide high quality customer experience and own customer solutioning. You will focus on managing troubleshooting tasks and provide resolution to issues. You will also be responsible for liaising with internal/external stakeholders to provide communication on customer issues and questions.
  
  
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video .

title: Global Scientific Content Manager HEVA and PDMD
description:
**Job title**
:
*Global Scientific Content Manager - HEVA and PDMD*

* Hiring Manager: Head/Group Lead/Team Lead – Scientific Writing
* Location: Hyderabad
* % of travel expected: As per business need
* Job type: Permanent and Full time

**About The Job**
**Our Team:**
*Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) is an internal Sanofi resource organization setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions. SBO strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA (including Patient-Driven Medicines Development [PDMD]), and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, Globally.*
**Main Responsibilities**
*The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:*

* Scientific Engagement

+ Support the development of the integrated strategy for scientific expert engagement; scientific congress, scientific events and medical education; scientific dissemination; and multichannel engagement (in collaboration with global and local colleagues covering this area) for the assigned therapeutic area/products.
+ Ensure timely execution of the scientific dissemination, scientific expert engagement, and medical multichannel engagement plans for global and countries.
+ Support the development of engagement plans by identifying new multi-channel customer facing/engagement initiatives that will enhance the customer experience for scientific and medical learning and improvement of patient care, incorporating patient-centric perspectives and patient-reported outcomes (PROs).
+ Closely track emerging and evolving digital technologies across industries, with a focus on healthcare & pharmaceutical industries, leveraging proof of concept to test ideas and channels.
+ Support the development and expansion of a network of experts in the disease areas of responsibility through expert/KOL mapping activities that includes identification, profiling, and segmentation of international experts including emerging leaders and rising stars. Work closely with geographic segments/regions and countries to harmonize expert mapping activities and engagement plans.
+ Establish and maintain professional and collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders, KOLs, scientific and academic societies, patient association and advocacy groups, medical communication and strategy companies involved.
+ Attend the medical meetings, advisory boards, outreach meetings at key institutions, and interact with key experts, academic societies, and advocacy groups.
+ Support the management and oversight of Scientific Congresses / Events, Donations and Other Contributions, advisory board planning & organization, compliance & transparency requirements.

* Scientific Publications and Medical Communications

+ Support the development and oversight of strategic scientific publication plans and execution of operational and tactical activities within the overall medical communication platforms for assigned products/disease areas of responsibility (including HEVA and PDMD research outputs such as patient-reported outcomes, qualitative patient studies, and real-world evidence).
+ Support the planning and proposal of content deliverables aligned with the strategic imperatives supporting the assigned products/disease areas. This includes reviewing and identifying relevant clinical findings, disease burden, unmet needs, patient-reported outcomes, and then proposing the development of corresponding compelling content.
+ Serve as a key scientific reviewer, performing thorough quality control, scientific/clinical accuracy checks, and peer review of all draft manuscripts, abstracts, posters, slide decks, and value communication documents prior to stakeholder/author circulation.
+ Ensuring timely delivery of high-quality, fair-balanced, scientifically/clinically accurate medical communications resources (including but not limited to proactive/reactive manuscript and poster/oral presentation slide decks, scientific platforms, lexicons, FAQs/trainings, symposia materials, medical booth materials, webinars, congress related microsites), scientific publication projects (including but not limited to manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and oral presentations, and enhanced content such as video, infographic, PLS, and podcast), internal communication and education resources (including but not limited to publication alerts, yammer communication of publications and congress events, pre-congress training slide deck, congress newsletters and reports), and integration of digital enhancements in medical publications in accordance with established timelines, compliance guidelines/policies, and budgets, in collaboration with the scientific writers and occasionally external agencies.
+ Providing oversight, quality control, scientific review, and project management, for scientific publication and medical communication projects, ensuring accuracy, quality, and adherence to project timelines.
+ Providing direction, constructive editorial review, and guidance to internal and external scientific writers, stakeholders, and regional partners regarding assigned projects, to ensure high-quality alignment with medical/scientific objectives, content development and dissemination processes, and adherence to Standard Operating Procedures.
+ Maintain knowledge of international requirements and guidance associated with scientific publications/medical communications and their associated tools (iEnvision, PromoMats etc.).
+ Ensure global and local teams are informed about the availability and relevance of developed content assets.
+ Analyse regularly content usage data to evolve medical content development.

* Additional

+ Maintain a keen understanding of the key stakeholder and patient community needs.
+ Incorporate customer-specific insights, gaps, patient burden/lived experience insights, and needs in crafting strategies supporting overall medical/business priorities.
+ Support the adoption of innovative content formats and processes, staying current with internal content evolution and industry trends.
+ Ensure designated activities are appropriately executed, adherent to corporate SOPs and policies, and consistent with relevant external scientific, legal, and regulatory standards.
+ Collaborate closely with colleagues as well as cross-functionally within a matrix organization (including HEVA, Global Medical Affairs, and Clinical teams) to ensure that information and knowledge transfer is conducted with internal and external stakeholders.
+ Maintain transparency with peers and colleagues across the organization, to produce aligned strategy and tactics, while promoting synergy and avoiding duplication of effort.
+ People: (1) Maintain effective relationship with the stakeholders (medical affairs, HEVA/PDMD, marketing, communications, regulatory affairs, medical scientific community etc.) within the allocated Global Business Unit and product – with an end objective to disseminate education and communication content as per requirement; (2) Interact effectively with internal teams and health care professionals on developed content; and (3) Constantly guide mentor, and peer-review the work of scientific writers in developing content and sharing expertise
+ Performance: (1) Oversee the development, scientific review, quality assurance, and ensure delivery of publication/medical education material (slide deck, abstract, poster, manuscript, patient-centric materials, etc.) aligned with medical strategy as per agreed timelines and quality; (2) Provide strategic inputs with individuals and institutions, which may serve as resources for publications and medical communications purpose; (3) Ensure the successful achievement of goals, operating within all policies, procedures, and guidance to ensure compliance with SOPs, including transparency reporting
+ Process: (1) Support in driving publication/medical communication processes and document review workflows; (2) Act as an expert in the assigned therapeutic area(s) and patient-driven methodology; (3) Assist the medical team in conducting comprehensive publication-need analysis; (4) Assist in driving the publication/medical communications plan and associated activities for the year identified for the region; (5) Work with selected vendors within the region to deliver the required deliverables as per defined process, providing critical scientific review of vendor outputs; (6) Leverage advanced training delivery tools and techniques thereby enhancing the effectiveness of training delivery; and (7) Support in designing an overall plan of action based on end-user feedback and improve course content and delivery
+ Stakeholder: (1) Work closely with medical and HEVA/PDMD teams globally and in regions/areas to identify publication needs and assist in developing assigned deliverables and (2) Liaise with medical department (global and local teams) to prepare relevant and customized deliverables

**About You**

* Experience: >8 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or related healthcare industry, with 2-3 years of understanding in all aspects of scientific publication and medical communications strategy, planning, and execution during all phases of drug development and post-launch/marketed products. Hands-on experience in peer reviewing scientific manuscripts, qualitative patient research, or HEVA/PDMD deliverables is highly desirable.
* Soft skills: Strong cross-functional collaboration, teamwork, and stakeholder management; outstanding interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills with exceptional time management skills; demonstrated peer-review and critical evaluation skills; ability to work independently and effectively in an internal and external environment; track record of managing multiple conflicting priorities in a rapidly evolving environment with successful outcomes; ability/willingness to maintain professional relationship with KOLs, scientific organizations/societies, advocacy groups, HCP authors, journals and publishers; strategic/critical thinking and problem-solving attitude; leadership, planning, organizing and negotiation skills; innovative mindset to help evolve current approaches to scientific engagement and communication/publications
* Technical skills: Therapeutic area/domain knowledge exposure; publication and medical communication processes; and/or project management; understanding of clinical trial, patient-reported outcomes (PROs), qualitative research methods, and real-world evidence study design and execution, statistical methods, and reporting requirements; ability to critically review scientific literature, data, and written content for accuracy, tone, and logical flow; knowledge of industry guidelines pertaining to stakeholder engagement and interactions with healthcare providers; understanding of good publication practices and guidance (GPP4, ICJME), Sunshine Act, Pharma Code of Conduct, and other guidance related to data communication; familiarity with publication and medical communication management tools (iEnvision, PromoMats, CRM); scientific expertise in assigned disease area and experience with digital/innovative technology is highly preferred
* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline or medical degree
* Languages: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written)

***Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary***
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

description:
**Description**
Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.
  
  
OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.
  
  
Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.
  
  
GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.
  
  
We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.
  
  
Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, HVAC controls, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  

* Support the development and execution of a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services

* Lead training sessions and development programs to continuously enhance the capabilities and technical skills of field RME teams and BMS Specialists
* Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team
* Willingness to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support across global time zones

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics/Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* Experience in BMS programming, commissioning & troubleshooting
* Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, and SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization
* Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP)
* Deep understanding of HVAC, lighting, utilities, field devices, and other building systems, as well as energy management principles
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize initiatives in a dynamic environment
* Strong problem-solving skills with a strategic and innovative mindset
* Organized and self-motivated to take ownership of complex tasks
* Provide 24/7 BMS support through flexible shift coverage, ensuring global customers receive timely and reliable assistance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in cross-regional BMS projects with multicultural teams
* Proficiency in cloud-based IoT platforms, data analytics, and visualization tools
* Certification in relevant programming languages or BMS systems
* Certification with Tridium Niagara
* Certification with Distech Controls
* Strong customer relationship management skills
* Experience and understanding of facility management and relevant electrical and mechanical aspects of BMS equipment
* Proficiency in additional spoken languages

title: Ariba Catalog Enablement Specialist
description:
**About Carrier**
**Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.**
**About This Role / Job Summary**
**The Ariba Catalog Enablement Specialist / Lead will enable, maintain, test, adopt, and govern supplier catalogs within SAP Ariba. The role will manage supplier catalog onboarding, PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalog implementation, catalog configuration and troubleshooting, UAT and go-live readiness, catalog adoption reporting, and stakeholder coordination with Procurement Operations, Supplier Management, Category Managers, AMS, Digital, IT, and suppliers.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Supplier Catalog Enablement**

* Support supplier onboarding and enablement into the SAP Ariba catalog environment, including supplier Ariba Network relationship setup and registration coordination.
* Manage catalog implementation projects across categories and regions for PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalogs.
* Coordinate with suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master-data teams to resolve missing information and enable go-live readiness.
* Maintain implementation trackers, action logs, risks, dependencies, and escalation visibility.

**Catalog Configuration, Administration & Issue Resolution**

* Manage incoming supplier catalogs, catalog subscriptions, catalog content updates, approver assignment checks, and catalog administration activities.
* Investigate catalog data issues, connectivity defects, price/content mismatches, transaction failures, and catalog escalations.
* Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, AMS, master data, Ariba support, and internal business owners.
* Document standard operating procedures, configuration decisions, and lessons learned for repeatable catalog enablement.

**Testing, Deployment & Go-Live Support**

* Define and execute catalog test scenarios, UAT plans, transaction validation, supplier connectivity checks, and go-live readiness validation.
* Coordinate test profiles, buyer / requester validation, issue tracking, defect closure, and deployment support.
* Support hypercare during launch and ensure operational handover to support teams after stabilization.
* Ensure catalog changes align with procurement channels, preferred supplier strategy, and business controls.

**Catalog Adoption, Reporting & Governance**

* Drive catalog utilization, preferred supplier adoption, and spend reallocation toward approved catalog suppliers.
* Track and report catalog adoption KPIs, productivity metrics, supplier performance, catalog utilization, and spend analytics.
* Support contract expiration tracking, supplier contract alignment, and coordination with category managers.
* Create user training materials, quick reference guides, supplier communications, and adoption campaigns.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, IT, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* 4+ years of experience in procurement operations, SAP Ariba catalog enablement, supplier enablement, P2P, eProcurement, or catalog administration.
* Practical understanding of SAP Ariba catalog processes, PunchOut, CIF / hosted catalogs, supplier onboarding, UAT, and catalog troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master-data stakeholders.
* Strong Excel / reporting, issue-resolution, stakeholder management, documentation, and project-tracking skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a global procurement CoE or shared-services model supporting multi-region catalog deployment.
* Knowledge of supplier master data, contract data, Ariba Network, Guided Buying, buying channels, and preferred supplier governance.
* Exposure to catalog analytics, spend leakage reduction, compliance monitoring, and adoption dashboards.
* Lean Six Sigma, SAP Ariba certification, project management, or Agile exposure preferred.
* Ability to translate catalog gaps into process fixes, training interventions, and adoption improvement plans.

**Success Measures / KPIs**

* Increased catalog utilization and preferred supplier adoption.
* On-time catalog implementations with effective testing, go-live readiness, and hypercare completion.
* Reduced catalog errors, escalations, non-catalog buying, and supplier transaction defects.
* Improved visibility through adoption reporting, spend analytics, and implementation trackers.
* Stronger alignment between catalog coverage, supplier strategy, contracts, and procurement channels.

**Key Stakeholders**

* Procurement Operations and Global SCM CoE
* Category Management and Regional Procurement teams
* Digital / IT / SAP Ariba support teams
* Supplier Enablement, Master Data, Contracts, and Suppliers
* Business requesters and approvers across global regions

title: Design Process Engineer
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
We are seeking a Robust Design Process Engineer to serve as a primary driver of engineering design process excellence within our commercial fire engineering organization. This role bridges technical design, quality engineering, and technical leadership to ensure products are innovative, compliant, and robust throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
You will evaluate and improve engineering design processes, define and deploy robust design standard work, and build organizational capability in risk management and reliability engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead and support the design and verification of complex products from concept through full-scale production, ensuring consistent application of robust design principles.
  
  
Own, review, improve, document, and deploy robust design standard work across the product development lifecycle, including DFM, DFA, and DFR.
  
  
Mentor, train, and coach design engineers on robust design methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, technical rigor, and learning.
  
  
Lead and support risk management activities, including FMEA, to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate technical risk.
  
  
Define training needs and ensure engineering teams are competent in technical risk management and robust design practices.
  
  
Participate in and influence design reviews, simulations (FEA, CFD), and testing activities, using data to continuously improve design standards and practices.
  
  
Partner cross-functionally with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and marketing to ensure design requirements are effectively integrated across all functions.
  
  
Support compliance with applicable safety, regulatory, and certification requirements relevant to commercial fire protection products.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  
  
Experience: 7–10+ years of experience in engineering design, including demonstrated technical leadership or process ownership.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
Experience with robust design and reliability methodologies (DFR, Six Sigma, FMEA).
  
  
Proficiency in data analysis and process mapping tools.
  
  
Experience supporting simulation and test-based design validation.
  
  
**Leadership & Soft Skills**
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  
  
Proven ability to mentor engineers and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  
  
Strategic mindset with continuous improvement orientation.
  
  
**Communication Skills**
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create technical documentation and deliver effective training.
  
  
**Global Experience**
Experience working with global teams across multiple time zones is a plus.
  
  
**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, Gloria and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

title: Associate Product Specialist
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
Your Team's Impact
  
  
Data Solutions is the industry-leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open: FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client’s workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The SBU contributes over $173M in ASV, with a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard Data Feed, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Real Time Products like Exchange Data Feed, Benchmark Feeds, the Open: FactSet Marketplace, Quantopian Enterprise, and other non-workstation initiatives.
  
  
The Data Solutions team is looking for a Associate Product Specialist to contribute to product management and support. description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte’s team within EBS Clients & Markets and help support priority accounts across the USI supporting EMEA region. In this role, you will work with Client Relationship Executives, Client Account Managers, and other account leaders to support account operations, strategic priorities, and client service activities. You will help keep account teams informed, organized, and positioned to deliver high-quality support across key account initiatives.

As a Services Specialist, Account Enablement on the team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Serve as a point of contact for account teams and support account operations, project coordination, and account excellence activities across priority accounts.
* Conduct research and analysis to support strategic priorities, issue-based requests, go-to-market planning, and industry- or region-specific account needs.
* Manage project activities end to end, including work allocation, stakeholder communication, quality reviews, prioritization, and delivery tracking.
* Coordinate with Deloitte stakeholders across geographies to clarify project scope, refine requirements, and support the development of research proposals, reports, and account deliverables.
* Support team operations by contributing ideas, sharing best practices, and helping onboard or mentor junior team members.

At Deloitte, clients are at the heart of everything we do. As a part of EBS Clients & Markets, the team is comprised of professionals who provide our most important client accounts with streamlined, cross-functional support. The teams are aligned to an industry (e.g., Energy, Resources & Industrials, Financial Services; Consumer; Life Sciences & Health Care; or Technology, Media & Telecom and Deloitte Private). **Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**

Required:
  
  

* Any Graduate / MBA. Background in Finance, Marketing and/or Business desirable
* 2-4 years of experience in account management, project management, marketing, business development, or market research
* Experience supporting key account management or account enablement activities
* Experience using Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Power BI, and Word
* Experience conducting business, financial, market, or industry research and analysis
* Experience preparing reports, insights, or recommendations for stakeholders
* Experience supporting projects across multiple stakeholders or geographies

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience supporting one or more industries
* Experience proposing research approaches or methodologies based on project scope
* Experience developing forward-looking insights or hypothesis-based analysis
* Experience creating visualizations or structured presentations of information
* Experience validating and triangulating sources for accuracy and relevance
* Experience reviewing work produced by junior team members

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Lead Application Support Specialist [T500-29612]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**Who are we:**

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Our opportunity:**

We're a small team that makes a big difference, and we're looking for someone who loves solving problems and helping others. If you're ready to grow with us and make an impact, we can't wait to hear from you!

**As an Application Support Specialist**
**your main responsibilities will include:**

* Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and operational support across a portfolio of Procurement, Risk Management, and related enterprise applications.
* Manage incidents, escalations, problems, and service requests, working closely with business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams to restore service and resolve issues.
* Analyze recurring issues, identify root causes, and contribute to the continuous improvement of applications, processes, support services, and user experience.
* Configure and administer applications, support integrations, perform release validation and testing, and ensure the ongoing stability and performance of supported platforms.
* Create, maintain, and enhance application, support, and knowledge documentation (SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and support procedures) to ensure effective service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-powered tools, and process improvements to enhance operational efficiency, knowledge management, and support effectiveness.

**Your Skills and Experience:**

**As an Application Support Specialist**
**your skills and qualifications will ideally include:**

**Your main responsibilities will include:**

* Provide
  **2nd/3rd level technical support at the application layer**
  across a portfolio of Procurement, Risk Management and related enterprise applications.
* Diagnose and resolve complex application incidents involving
  **application configuration, workflows, business rules, permissions, data, integrations, APIs and application behaviour**
  .
* **Design, configure, test, document and implement application changes**
  , managing them through the required IT governance, risk assessment, change management and release processes.
* Perform technical application administration, including
  **configuration, access and role management, interface troubleshooting, scheduled processes and application-level controls**
  .
* Manage incidents, escalations, problems and service requests, working with business stakeholders, vendors and other technical teams to restore service and resolve underlying application issues.
* Perform root-cause analysis of recurring issues and implement permanent fixes, configuration improvements and technical enhancements.
* Support application integrations and data flows, including troubleshooting APIs, interfaces, authentication and application-to-application communication.
* Perform release validation, regression testing and post-release verification to maintain application stability and functionality.
* Create and maintain application and support documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles and technical support procedures.
* Identify opportunities to use automation and AI-powered tools to improve troubleshooting, support processes, knowledge management and operational efficiency.

**Role focus:**

* This is a
  **hands-on enterprise application specialist role requiring technical expertise at the application layer**
  . The focus is on configuring, troubleshooting, administering and enhancing enterprise business applications and supporting their integrations and data.
* The role is
  **not primarily focused on infrastructure or application hosting**
  , such as server administration, operating systems, infrastructure monitoring/observability, network administration, application installation or hosting-platform operations.

**Your Skills and Experience:**

**Must have:**

* 2–5 years of experience in
  **2nd or 3rd level enterprise application support**
  , with hands-on responsibility for troubleshooting and administering business-critical enterprise or SaaS applications.
* Practical experience with
  **application configuration and technical administration**
  , such as workflows, business rules, permissions/roles, application settings, integrations, APIs or data.
* Experience implementing
  **application changes through the full change lifecycle**
  , including analysis, configuration or development, testing, documentation, approval, deployment and post-release validation.
* Experience investigating complex incidents and performing
  **application-level root-cause analysis**
  , rather than primarily infrastructure monitoring or operational escalation.
* Familiarity with
  **ITIL, Agile and DevOps**
  ways of working and IT governance/change-management processes.
* Basic programming or scripting skills in
  **Python, JavaScript or TypeScript**
  .
* Practical experience using AI-powered productivity and development tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT or similar for troubleshooting, research, documentation and operational efficiency.
* Understanding of Generative AI concepts, capabilities, limitations and responsible use, including data privacy, security and validation of AI-generated outputs.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors and end users.
* Professional proficiency in English.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with
  **REST APIs, JSON, integration troubleshooting and automation tools**
  .
* Knowledge of enterprise Procurement, Risk Management or other business-critical applications and their associated business processes.
* Experience working with configurable SaaS platforms where technical application specialists are responsible for
  **configuration, integrations, releases and application lifecycle changes**
  .
