title: Senior Product Specialist - Deep Sector-7
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Your Team's Impact**
Content & Technology Solutions (CTS) is the industry leading content delivery platform. Clients seamlessly access organized and connected content that is easily discoverable, explorable, and procured via the Open:FactSet Marketplace. Data is delivered via a variety of technologies and formats that meet the needs of our client's workflows. By enabling our clients to utilize their preferred choice of industry standard databases, programming languages, and data visualization tools, we empower them to focus on the core competencies needed to drive their business. The Strategic Business Unit has experienced a double-digit year-over-year growth rate. Our solutions portfolio includes Standard DataFeeds, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Benchmark Feeds, and the Open: FactSet Marketplace.
  
  
The CTS Product Management team is looking for a dynamic Senior Product Specialist to join our Deep Sector Team to contribute to the expansion of Deep Sector Feeds in FactSet Fundamentals. Deep Sector is an initiative where FactSet collects new content, improves existing collection efforts in fundamentals, as well as develops new reports and functionality across 9 sectors: Banks, Insurance, Real Estate, Power & Utilities, TMT, Metals & Mining, Oil & Gas, Specialty Finance and Healthcare.
  
  
In this role, you will be expected to gain a comprehensive understanding of CTS products and delivery technologies, to be a key contributor to defining and expanding the product packages available, and to enhance and add features that provide connectivity, scalability, and enhanced usability. You will work closely with a broadly distributed group of Content, Product, Strategy, Sales & Support, Engineering, and Quality Assurance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Insights**
– Derives insights to support product bets
  
  

* Regularly gathers, Analyzes, and interprets feedback directly from clients and prospects to understand their problems and the gaps in our solutions and in the marketplace.
* Participates in product discovery. Proactively identifies the market and validates the opportunity to prove whether a solution is valuable, viable, feasible and usable before developing it.
* Contributes to defining the metrics that will measure product outcomes.

**Strategy**
– Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results
  
  

* Performs research and analysis that contributes to the product vision, strategic framework and roadmap.

**Execution**
– Delivers on product outcomes
  
  

* Serves as SME on the quality and nuances of the product. Knows the top issues and how to troubleshoot them. Serves as an internal resource to educate junior team members and support help desk on troubleshooting and best practices.
* Supports Product Managers by prioritizing issues that are critical to fix in order to improve the customer experience. Defines the problem space correctly and experiment with potential solutions before suggesting a specific fix.
* Adept at separating bugs from user error and stability issues. Escalates issues to Engineering appropriately.
* Assists to clearly define user needs and acceptance criteria with development teams. Helps to prioritize needs and provides clarity for iterating on solutions.
* Prioritizes the instrumentation and reporting of key product metrics.
* Is exposed to Agile principles and best practices.

**Leadership**
– Inspires cross-functional teams to achieve great outcomes
  
  

* Gives prompt and candid feedback to cross-functional team members.
* Coaches and mentors junior team members.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech/MCA or BBA/MBA. A combination of tech and finance would be ideal, although not mandatory.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy and roadmap
* Ability to troubleshoot client issues and solve them with a combination of creativity, analytical skills, and subject matter expertise.
* Understands how to leverage tools and frameworks for product management such as user personas, empathy mapping, and prioritization frameworks.
* Is product-oriented. Can take a stand to say “No” to stakeholders/engineering and starts by defining the problems, goals and needs, and does experimentation to uncover the best solution.
* Familiarity with query languages (e.g., SQL) and programming languages commonly utilized in the financial industry (e.g., Python, R).
* Knowledge of data sets and technology solutions commonly utilized in the financial industry is a plus.

Knowledge of data and technology workflows and end users common in the financial industry is a plus.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.

title: Manager – Corporate Affairs, Internal Workplace Communications
description:
The Manager, Internal Workplace Communications, is a strategic employee communications partner who will help leaders of Corporate Functions teams translate their priorities, initiatives and employee experience commitments into communications to their teams. At Amgen, Workplace Communications represents Human Resources (HR) and the enterprise-enabling expertise that supports the people who make and deliver our medicines.
  
  
Working across functions and regions, this manager will lead development of communications, advise functional leaders and program teams, and develop audience-centered content that builds employee understanding, business confidence and change adoption.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Internal Communication Strategy and Delivery:**

* Develop and deliver internal communications plans and strategies consistent with Amgen’s global, functional and local communications strategies and aligned with strategic objectives.
* Write, edit and oversee high-quality communications, including leader messages, talking points, intranet content, toolkits, FAQs and presentation materials.
* Partner with Corporate Affairs and functional communicators to align messages, milestones, audiences, channels and leader actions across the enterprise.
* Turn complex business and functional information into concise, employee-centered narratives that explain what is changing, why it matters and what people need to do.
* Manage communications projects and deliverables from intake through delivery, including timeline development, approvals, risk identification and assessment and implementation/publication.
* Proactively identify ongoing communications opportunities and capitalize on existing moments or milestones to further impact strategic communications activities and drive business outcomes.
* Make recommendations to improve enterprise communication tactics and internal channel effectiveness across email, intranet, community platforms, presentations, and similar.
* Maintain a consistent enterprise voice, clear editorial grammar and style standards, and appropriate coordination with Legal, Compliance, HR and other review partners.

**Communication Project Coordination:**

* Build and sustain cooperative relationships with team members across Law, Finance, Human Resources (HR) including Wellness and People, Culture and Engagement (PCE), Digital Technology & Innovation (DTI), Corporate Affairs, Business Development, World Compliance & Business Ethics (WC&BE), and the Results Delivery Office (RDO).
* Find opportunities to create collaboration, particularly between HR and other stakeholders.
* Lead assigned communications workstreams, including planning, tracking, stakeholder coordination and delivery.
* Partner with Corporate Functions teams to develop timelines, workback plans, presentation content and speaker talking points for All Staff meetings.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders (including consulting agency teams) to ensure timely and accurate communication.
* Analyze communication performance and feedback to improve content, channel choices and campaign design.

**Confidentiality & Professionalism:**

* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Advise and ensure alignment between communications and team leader priorities.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in making day-to-day communications recommendations and escalate high-risk, sensitive or cross-functional decisions appropriately.

**Note that the role and responsibilities may evolve as the business changes and priorities shift.**
**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Master's of Bachelor’s degree and 8 - 12 years of experience, at least 6 years of direct experience

**Functional Skills:**
**Must-Have Skills:**

* Demonstrated experience developing integrated communication plans and delivering content for diverse, global employee audiences.
* Strong writing, editing and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex information into clear, credible and actionable messages.
* Proven ability to influence through partnership in a matrixed environment and to manage multiple workstreams with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Strong organizational and independent time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and execute on deadlines.
* Comfort using communication metrics, employee feedback and digital-channel insights to improve effectiveness.
* Familiarity and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and virtual collaboration tools (e.g., Teams, WebEx)

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Knowledge of regulatory affairs and pharmaceutical industry terminology.
* Experience working in a multinational environment with global teams.
* Experience supporting enterprise change initiatives.

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong judgment and perspective when evaluating first draft materials generated by colleagues and/or AI.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and adaptability to changing priorities.
* Ability to respectfully challenge assumptions, raise alternative perspectives and recommend solutions with teammates or leaders through constructive dialogue.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to build positive relationships across teams.
* High degree of professionalism and interpersonal skills.
* Openness to feedback, adaptability and the ability to incorporate diverse perspectives into stronger communications outcomes.

title: Senior Consultant - Veeva Safety - Managed Services (Remote)
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
**Managed Services**
is provided to our R&D customers after they go live with Veeva applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
  
  
Our
**Managed Services Team**
comprises 90+ consultants in Europe, of which 5+ are in the Safety Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are growing our team every year and opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.
  
  
Veeva is looking for Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance consultants to join the Managed Services team and support our Vault Safety solution after implementation.
  
  
**As a Safety Consultant**
, you will support a group of biopharmaceutical customers assigned to you. Your task will be to understand their business processes, provide guidance, discuss Vault changes, and apply all the required configurations. You will also actively collaborate with other teams at Veeva, shape ideas, enhance our delivery model, and work closely with our product management team to communicate the customer’s requirements and meet the evolving needs of the industry.
  
  
**To thrive in this role**
, you are able to adapt and learn new technology. You have been configuring, supporting, or implementing software solutions. You enjoy working with customers, speak fluent English, and have strong communication and presentation skills. You enjoy working in fast paced environments, are a team player and fast learner .
  
  
This is a remote, full-time role with Veeva with occasional travel to the Veeva Hyderabad site.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Help to keep up to date and implement new features within the Veeva Safety suite
* Work closely with customer business and IT staff to understand their requirements
* Think critically to help design the solution your customers request as well as the solution they have not requested but may need
* Act as customer liaison, managing communication between implementation and maintenance teams, customer stakeholders, and internal Veeva Product teams
* Guide customers in adopting Vault and industry best practices as part of post-implementation programs focused on the holistic success of the customer
* Drive change management methodology for our customers switching from on-premises to SaaS solutions

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of life sciences industry experience, with the majority of time spent in the Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance domain and experience in a consulting function
* Knowledge of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance processes and regulations
* Must have a decent experience writing complex SQL queries on safety data sets
* Should have worked on implementing safety systems like Aris / Argus / Emperica / Commonwealth / RxLogix / or any home-grown safety system
* Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and ensure delivery to a high degree of satisfaction
* Good to have experience building aggregate and analytical reports on safety data set
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
* Must have worked in an individual contributor capacity in the previous employments
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements, create corresponding solution designs, and willingness to “roll up your sleeves” to design and deliver Vault Safety
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements
* Ability to travel for about : 25% of the project time
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required
* Has the right attitude and mindset to work towards customer success

****Nice to Have****

* Proven track record supporting high impact global system implementation programs as a consultant, business, or IT lead, and/or business sponsor
* Direct experience with Argus and/or other drug safety applications
* Life science, computer science, or related degree
* SaaS/Cloud experience
* Experience in services delivery management and/or systems implementation
* Locality to major life sciences customer hub (Bangalore, IN; Hyderabad, IN)

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health Insurance fully covered for family, including Employee’s parents
* Work anywhere culture which allows flexible work location
* Fitness benefits fully taken care by Veeva
* 1% Charitable giving program

description:

This role ensures that ServiceNow enhancements, implementations, and platform changes are well defined, business aligned, user focused, and delivered in line with governance, SIAM operating models, and enterprise standards. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, process owners, platform teams, architects, and delivery partners, the Business Analyst/Technical Analyst/Technical Analyst drives requirement quality, process clarity, adoption readiness, and successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.
  
  
At dsm-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work, benefiting our People, Customers & Communities and driving business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Business Analysis & Requirements Management
* Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product owners, and platform teams to capture and clarify business requirements for ServiceNow initiatives.
* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and backlog items.
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, prioritized, and aligned with platform standards and out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities wherever possible.
* Support demand intake, impact assessment, scope definition, and change prioritization across ServiceNow modules.
* Process Design & ServiceNow Solution Alignment
* Analyze current-state processes and support the design of future-state workflows on the ServiceNow platform.
* Work with architects and functional leads to ensure requirements are translated into practical, scalable, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions.
* Support solution design across modules such as ITSM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, CMDB, ITOM, GRC, Legal Service Delivery, and custom applications as applicable.
* Promote process simplification, standardization, automation, and reuse of platform capabilities.

* Maintain and refine the product backlog in collaboration with product owners, scrum teams, and delivery partners.
* Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirement walkthroughs, build clarifications, and functional reviews.
* Define and support test scenarios, UAT planning, defect triage, and business validation to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.
* Track requirement traceability from demand through design, build, testing, deployment, and adoption.
* Governance, Controls & Change Readiness
* Ensure requirements and process designs comply with ServiceNow governance, security, data, audit, and compliance standards.
* Support impact assessments for platform changes, releases, integrations, and process changes.
* Prepare business stakeholders for adoption through process documentation, training inputs, communication support, and transition readiness activities.
* Identify risks, dependencies, open decisions, and requirement gaps early and drive timely resolution.
* Reporting, Insights & Continuous Improvement
* Use ServiceNow data, reports, dashboards, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support continual service improvement initiatives focused on user experience, automation, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Contribute to roadmap inputs by identifying recurring pain points, process bottlenecks, and value opportunities.
* Promote data-driven decisions and measurable business outcomes from ServiceNow delivery.
* Stakeholder & Vendor Collaboration
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders, process owners, platform owners, architects, SIAM teams, and delivery partners.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, demos, and decision discussions with clear documentation and follow-through.
* Coordinate with system integrators and internal teams to clarify scope, resolve requirement questions, and validate delivery outputs.
* Act as a trusted functional advisor to stakeholders on ServiceNow process and requirement topics.
* Technical Architecture Requirements
* Define and maintain scalable ServiceNow technical architecture aligned with enterprise standards, platform governance, security requirements, and long-term product roadmap.
* Assess technical feasibility, solution options, integration patterns, data models, and platform impacts for new demands, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Guide configuration versus customization decisions, promote reuse of out-of-the-box capabilities, and ensure solutions remain upgrade-safe, maintainable, and cost-effective.
* Provide technical oversight across integrations, workflows, automation, APIs, data quality, CMDB dependencies, access controls, and environment management.
* Review solution designs, technical specifications, release plans, and deployment readiness to manage risks, dependencies, performance, resilience, and compliance obligations.

**We bring**

* A supportive environment where you’re empowered to grow and share your ideas.
* An inclusive and multicultural team with respect for everyone
* A dynamic work environment with many challenges that give you the possibility to work autonomously and with a team in finding the right solutions.

**You bring**

* 6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst/Technical Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in enterprise IT platforms.
* Strong experience working with ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, or platform operations.
* Good understanding of ITSM processes such as Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Catalog, and CMDB; exposure to HRSD, CSM, SPM, ITOM, GRC, or Legal Service Delivery is an advantage.
* Proven ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business requirements, and functional specifications.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, UAT, and release support.
* Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to balance business value, user experience, process standardization, governance, and delivery practicality.

At dsm-firmenich, we don’t just meet expectations – we go beyond them.
  
  
Join our global team powered by science, creativity, and a shared purpose: to bring progress to life.
  
  
  
  
From elevating health to making fortified food and sustainable skincare, the impact of your work here will be felt by millions – every single day. Whether it’s fragrance that helps you focus, alternative meat that’s better for the planet, or reducing sugar without losing flavor, this is where you help shape the future of nutrition, health, and beauty for everyone, everywhere.
  
  
And while you’re making a difference, we’ll make sure you’re growing too. With learning that never stops, a culture that lifts you up and the freedom to move across businesses, teams, and borders. Your voice matters here. And your ideas? They’re essential to our future.

**For further information, please contact Kanika Maloo, Talent Acquisition Partner (kanika.maloo@dsm-firmenich.com).**

title: IT Quality-Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
  
  
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the execution of complex or novel assignments requiring strategic planning and development of new and/or improved validation techniques, deviations, and procedures. In this position you will supervise validation activities through internal audits and conduct risk assessments to identify the need for requalification and establish policies for computer system re-validation.
  
  
This individual will actively participate during all phases of qualification/validation of computerized systems: evaluate projects; provide guidance and technical information to others (lead qualification/validation activities); determine and establish requirements for qualification/validation of each individual system/equipment; formulate independent decisions related to qualification/verification activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Review validation/qualification packages of computerized systems for completeness and accuracy, sound rationale, Regulatory expectations, compliance with validation policies and procedures, and accurate data analysis. Serve as Owner or QA Contact for Minor and Major Deviations. Compare results against acceptance criteria and work with appropriate departments to resolve exceptions and deviations. Bring critical exceptions or deviations to management’s attention and initiate and enforce necessary improvements and corrections to established systems and processes. Initiate, implement, and track completion of Change Control and deviation requests related to computer systems. Participation and support of regulatory inspections.
  
  
Validation
  
  

* Demonstrated expertise in risk-based validation (RBV) methodologies, providing execution and guidance to cross-functional teams on complex GxP projects while ensuring alignment with Computer Software Assurance (CSA) principles.
* Proven ability to serve as the QA point of contact for assigned GxP systems, ensuring timely review and approval of documentation in compliance with Amgen’s standard operating procedures and applicable regulatory standards.
* Change Control Management: Drive Change Request (CR) and Change Control processes, from initiation through approval, ensuring accurate system impact assessment and documentation. (e.g Trackwise/Veeva , ServiceNow)
* Validation Documentation: Review and approve all validation documentation, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal quality standards.
* Requirement Specifications & Test Protocols: Review and approve Requirement Specifications, Design Specifications, Test Protocols, Validation Plans, Summary Reports, and Requirement Traceability Matrices.
* System Life Cycle Documents: Review and approve System Life Cycle Documents (e.g., test protocols) prior to their use in production.
* Data Integrity Assessments: Review and approve Data Integrity Assessments to ensure data is accurate and complies with regulatory standards.

Periodic Review/Audit Trail
  
  

* System Periodic Reviews & Audit Trails: Review and approve periodic system reviews and audit trail reports to ensure system integrity and compliance.

**Supplier**
Management
  
  

* Supplier Evaluations: Provide support for supplier evaluations as needed, ensuring suppliers meet quality, compliance, and performance standards.

**Deviation & CAPA Management:**

* Initiate and manage deviations (major and minor) as required. Serve as the primary QA contact for deviations, ensuring proper investigation and resolution.
* Act as the quality reviewer and approve for problem records in ServiceNow, ensuring that all records meet internal quality standards.
* CAPA & Effectiveness Verification (EV): Serve as the QA contact or owner for Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and Effectiveness Verification (EV) records, ensuring timely and effective resolution.

Responsible as a Business Owner for overseeing and managing specific GxP Computerized Systems programs and projects, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and alignment with business objectives. Independently develop solutions that are thorough, practical and consistent with functional objectives.
  
  
Review and approve operational and administrative Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions, ensuring alignment with regulatory and quality standards.
  
  
Apply analytical skills to evaluate complex problems, utilizing both qualitative and quantitative data, including trend analysis, to develop effective solutions.
  
  
Contributes to continuous improvement efforts and initiatives.
  
  
Assists with training initiatives and strategy as required.
  
  
Provides support for the Management Review Process when needed.
  
  
Supports the Integrated Systems Assessment (ISA) Process as necessary.
  
  
Participates in and aids with regulatory inspections as required.
  
  
The individual will be required to work from our office located in Hyderabad India (Amgen India-AIN). The candidate will be required to go into the office as dictated by the site policy.
  
  
**What We Expect From You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree with a minimum of 7 years experience in Software and Systems Quality assurance OR
* Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 10 years of Software and Systems Quality assurance experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of the regulations outlined in 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP standards.
* Proven experience in the validation of computerized systems (GxP).
* Strong understanding and application of GxP regulations (GMP, GLP, GCP, GPvP, GDP).
* Experience managing quality assurance processes, including Major and Minor Deviations.
* Demonstrated ability to handle and resolve complex quality issues using analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong decision-making abilities with the capacity to drive tasks to completion.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Leadership skills with experience leading projects, teams, or tasks.
* Experience with tools and systems such as HP ALM, Jira, Confluence, Track Wise , Documentation Management Systems, LIMS, SAP and Maximo.
* Broad technical expertise within specialty area and familiarity with industry standards.
* Ability to provide training, guidance, and contribute to team quality.
* Works closely with senior staff and external experts to extend capabilities and enhance performance.

**Data Analysis Skills (Good To Have)-**

* Perform data analysis to create impactful visuals and dashboards for informed decision-making.
* Design clear, engaging charts and graphics for presentations and reports.
* Utilize tools like Power BI, Smartsheet, or similar to develop interactive, data-driven visuals.
* Translate complex data into concise, compelling visual stories for diverse audiences.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align visual outputs with business goals.

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.
  
  
**Apply now**
**for a career that defies imagination**
Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.
  
  
**careers.amgen.com**
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.
  
  
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Operations Management Intern
description:
Company Description: IHM Connect delivers smart, adaptable ERP solutions that help organizations streamline operations and drive growth across multiple industries. The company’s flagship product, Campus Connect, supports schools with integrated finance, HR, attendance, and result management to improve efficiency and student-focused outcomes. Beyond education, IHM Connect serves sectors such as real estate and manufacturing with tailored systems that address specific operational challenges. Its ERP solutions integrate with existing processes to provide real-time data and actionable insights for better decision-making. As the company expands into new markets, it remains committed to user-friendly technology that enhances productivity and reduces inefficiencies.

Role Description: The Operations Management is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This position focuses on supporting client onboarding, understanding client requirements, and ensuring smooth adoption of IHM Connect ERP solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with clients to address queries, tracking client satisfaction, coordinating with internal technical and sales teams, and maintaining updated records of client interactions. The intern will assist in preparing presentations, reports, and follow-up communication, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve client experience. This role offers exposure to ERP implementation, customer success processes, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.

Qualifications

* Strong customer-focused mindset, with skills in Customer Satisfaction and Account Management to build and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Effective Communication skills (verbal and written) to interact with diverse stakeholders and present information clearly.
* Interest or foundational skills in Sales and Consulting to support solution positioning, client needs assessment, and upsell opportunities.
* Basic understanding of ERP or software solutions, and the ability to learn product features quickly.
* Good organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail in documentation and follow-ups.
* Ability to work collaboratively on-site in Hyderabad with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Onboarding & Implementation**

* Manage end-to-end onboarding process for schools and business clients
* Coordinate data collection, system setup, and implementation timelines
* Ensure smooth migration of operational data to the IHM Connect platform
* Conduct onboarding sessions and training for client teams

Operational Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
* Monitor platform adoption and ensure proper usage of modules (HR, Finance, CRM, WhatsApp Automation, etc.)
* Identify operational gaps and proactively suggest improvements
* Ensure SLA adherence and timely resolution of client issues

Relationship & Retention Management

* Maintain regular communication with school management and business owners
* Support renewals and contract negotiations in coordination with the sales team
* Address escalations and ensure long-term client satisfaction
* Work on improving retention and reducing churn

Strategic Operations & Process Optimization

* Build and improve SOPs for onboarding and client management
* Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks
* Coordinate cross-functionally to improve internal workflows
* Assist in pricing discussions, service scope alignment, and operational feasibility

description:

.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
The
**Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst**
will play an important role in supporting Micron's Structured Data Access Control (sDAC) program and related data governance initiatives. This role analyzes business processes, identifies opportunities for automation and efficiency, develops reporting and dashboard solutions, supports operational workloads, and contributes to projects that strengthen secure and compliant access to enterprise structured data.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong analytical thinking with process improvement, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and project execution skills. Working closely with technical and business teams, they will transform complex governance processes into actionable insights and help drive continuous improvements across access management and governance workflows.
  
  
This position supports both day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives, helping advance governance modernization, workflow automation, and user experience improvements across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Structured Data Access Control (SDAC) process and related governance workflows along with the knowledge of Role Based Access Control (RBAC) and data security management for integration.
* Define, document and improve business processes, requirements, workflows, operating procedures, governance standards, user guidance, training material and communications.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and efficiency improvements.
* Leveraging AI powered tools and other technologies to improve analysis, research, and productivity.
* Serve as a project contributor, feature owner, or workstream lead for governance initiatives. Includes tracking and communicating project status, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to understand business needs, gather requirements, and address process challenges.
* Facilitate partnerships with developers to define business requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in requirements gathering, planning, testing, deployment, change management, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validation activities.
* Collaborate with BISOs, architects, DBAs, developers, governance teams, and business stakeholders.
* Support user adoption efforts and partner with governance and security teams on RBAC-related initiatives.
* Perform deep data analysis to detect patterns and drive to results. Along with developing data-driven recommendations to improve service quality, cycle time, operational effectiveness, and user experience. Monitor service levels and operational health.
* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI, ServiceNow, and governance reporting solutions, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Analyze trends, bottlenecks, Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance, and operational health metrics to provide actionable insights, create executive-ready reporting and present to leadership and stakeholder on governance recommendation.
* Support operational ticket queues, governance workflows, and triage and resolution of access request review along with assisting users and stakeholders with governance-related inquiries.
* Support audit, certification, and compliance activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Business Data Analytics, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of work experience in business analysis, governance, operations, analytics, or process improvement.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, developing reports, dashboards, and metrics using Power BI, ServiceNow and the Microsoft 365 suites.
* Self-motivated, organized, and highly capable of carrying out detailed plans with limited direction.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive with a positive attitude, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams across geographical and organizational cultures and to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting data governance, access management, and IAM governance programs, with familiarity in RBAC concepts.
* Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) or Oracle Database role and direct access permissions.
* Knowledge of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies. PMP, Scrum, Agile, or Business Analysis certifications are a plus.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflow design and automation, Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (SharePoint, Planner, Power Automate), and Power BI data modeling and advanced visualization techniques.

Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Senior Program Specialist is an individual contributor role. This position is responsible for supporting execution of business operations and administrative management of USP’s Verification Programs. The role drives coordination of projects, tools, and processes that support market development to drive customer engagement, support internal and external communications, and enhance visibility into program activities against key success metrics. Key responsibilities also include preparation and distribution of internal reports, lead and prospect management, client relationship management (CRM), data and reporting optimization, and performance metric tracking. In addition, the position contributes to broader program operations and continuous improvement initiatives that support the growth of USP’s Verification Programs.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The pursuit manager works closely with senior partners and other pursuit/sales professionals in support of priority competitive opportunities with US-based clients. Depending upon the pursuit, the role may also involve coordination aspects of proposal and presentation development. * Strategic management:

+ Oversee end-to-end RFP and proposal processes, including planning, win theme strategy, proposal writing, and oral presentation coaching.
+ Advise and collaborate with client service professionals, providing strategic communication insights and leadership.
+ Leverage proprietary GenAI tools to bring efficiency to the pursuit process, share meaningful insights with client service teams, and guide the strategy.
+ Exhibit outstanding verbal skills in facilitating and distilling complex discussions; demonstrate a finely tuned ability to sift through a discussion, extracting the most significant information and action items.
+ Develop and implement effective pursuit and messaging strategies, lead meetings, and present in various forums.
+ Negotiate and mediate to resolve conflicts and reach consensus quickly.
+ Direct competitive intelligence and knowledge management efforts to inform pursuit messaging.
+ Influence and persuade stakeholders to adopt best practices and innovative approaches.

* Teaming, collaboration, and leading:

+ Demonstrate exceptional business insight, judgment, and executive presence.
+ Build trusted advisor relationships with senior clients (VP and C-level), understanding their objectives and success factors.
+ Collaborate with partner advisors and graphic design professionals to deliver high-quality, brand-compliant proposals and presentations.
+ Mentor and develop junior team members, fostering growth and collaboration.
+ Navigate large, complex pursuits to positively influence team dynamics and manage expectations.

* Operational:

+ Develop, organize, and manage proposal content and collateral, ensuring version control and quality across all components.
+ Engage with the pursuit team strategically; pose questions that encourage a team to consider all aspects of the client’s position, and draw out essential messaging.
+ Taking ownership of quality, maintain a quality checklist to ensure 100% quality on all documents
+ Contribute to the development of pursuit best practices, proposal databases, marketing materials, and prospect presentations.
+ Develop and coordinate effective pursuit communications strategies; advise the pursuit team on communication objectives, messages, and tone; and manage the overall process to develop value-focused deliverables.
+ Other activities include the development and implementation of leading pursuit practices, the development of content for the proposal database, internal and external marketing brochures, and presentations for prospect meetings.

Qualifications

* Master’s degree in Business, Management, or a related field.
* Experience using GenAI tools and demonstrated ability to leverage technology for effective proposal development.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
* Intellectual curiosity and ability to quickly learn about a wide variety of topics.
* Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Initiative and ability to interact effectively with all levels of management.
* Strong project management skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office.

Identifies, develops, and implements process improvement initiatives or solutions designed to enhance data collection, system, and process performance. Creates scalable, efficient, and flexible business designs that balance people, process, and systems. Measures and reviews data and performance metrics on an ongoing basis to identify and resolve issues. Drives solution deployment across the organization including documentation and user training.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or related field.

OR
  
  
Associate's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or related field and 2+ years of related business process analysis experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
High School Diploma or equivalent and 3+ years of related business process analysis experience.
  
  
Join our team to transform Qualcomm's Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) space by improving processes and systems, boosting operational efficiency, and driving innovation with AI and other advanced technologies. We aim to deliver effective solutions that integrate seamlessly with business operations while providing exceptional support and value to stakeholders globally.
  
  
In this dynamic role, you will become an expert in
**Agiloft**
, Qualcomm's CLM platform, and serve as a key member of the CLM Operations team. You will provide operational support, configuration assistance, testing, documentation, training, and data quality oversight to ensure the platform remains secure, reliable, and effective for users globally.
  
  
Working closely with business users, contract managers, system administrators, IT teams, and third-party vendors, you will troubleshoot issues, validate enhancements, maintain documentation, develop training materials, execute testing activities, and support ongoing platform improvements. You will play an important role in ensuring high-quality system data, adherence to established policies and security requirements, and a positive end-user experience.
  
  
This role is part of Qualcomm’s global CLM team with members located in both Hyderabad and San Diego. Regular collaboration across time zones is required. Candidates should be comfortable participating in evening meetings approximately twice per week, with additional flexibility as needed to support project activities, production issues, training, testing, upgrades, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented, customer-focused professional with experience supporting enterprise business systems such as Agiloft, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or similar low-code platforms. The ideal candidate communicates effectively with both technical and business users, takes ownership of assigned work, maintains high standards for quality and accuracy, and is committed to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Operations, or related field
* 2+ years of Supply Chain, Information Technology, Operations, or related work experience
* 1+ year of experience supporting, configuring, testing, or administering enterprise business applications such as Agiloft, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar low-code platforms
* 1+ year customer-facing support experience
* 1+ year of experience with data analysis, reporting, or data quality activities
* 1+ year of experience working in a large matrixed organization
* Experience creating user documentation, training materials, knowledge articles, or support content
* Experience performing system testing, validation, QA, or user acceptance testing activities
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Comfortable working with global teams and supporting stakeholders across multiple time zones
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provides day-to-day operational support for Qualcomm's Contract Lifecycle Management platform
* Assesses, troubleshoots, and resolves end-user issues, questions, and enhancement requests while meeting established service levels
* Performs configuration and administrative activities within Agiloft and other supported platforms following established governance processes
* Executes QA, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing activities for system enhancements, upgrades, and defect fixes
* Creates, maintains, and executes test scripts and test plans
* Develops and maintains user documentation, process guides, knowledge articles, training materials, and quick reference guides
* Delivers end-user training and supports adoption of new features and functionality
* Performs data quality reviews and supports contract data cleanup and governance initiatives
* Helps ensure platform configurations, data, and operational processes comply with security, governance, and policy requirements
* Runs reports, performs data analysis, and supports business reporting needs
* Participates in system releases, upgrades, validation efforts, and production support activities
* Collaborates effectively with business stakeholders, contract managers, attorneys, IT teams, and external vendors
* Identifies opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, standardization, and process improvements
* Actively manages individual priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
* Seeks learning opportunities within the industry and explores, evaluates, and recommends new technologies and trends

**Level Of Responsibility**

* Works under close supervision.
* Responsible for own work. Decision-making is limited.
* Requires strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively support users and collaborate with stakeholders.
* Works within established department objectives and operational processes.
* Errors typically impact timelines, data quality, user experience, or operational efficiency and may require additional effort to correct.
* Tasks range from routine system support and testing activities to more complex troubleshooting and operational analysis.
* Problem solving is typically focused on investigating issues, identifying root causes, validating solutions, and ensuring quality outcomes.

title: Engineer - Controls Platform NPI
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.

**Rôles et responsabilités**

Comprend l'opérabilité, la définition des limites, l'optimisation du cycle, la logique de contrôle, les logiciels liés au contrôle, les capteurs, les algorithmes matériels et logiciels, ainsi que les informations en retour permettant de contrôler les performances des dispositifs, sous-systèmes et systèmes.

Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.

Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. **Education\***
CA/CPA, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance

3 - 5 years experience

MUM/HYD/CHN

title: Senior Manager, AIN Documentation, Content Create and Automation (DCCA)
description:
Location: India | Scope: Global service supporting Amgen sites
  
  
Under minimal direction, the Senior Manager, DCCA leads a DS, DP or FDP team based in India that creates and revises controlled GMP documentation for Amgen sites globally. The role owns the service-delivery model that enables reliable, compliant, and accurate documentation support - delivering to agreed service-level agreements while driving right-first-time quality, predictable turnaround, and continuous improvement. Hours for this role may vary based on global time zones, which could include hybrid hours, on call requirements, and flexible working hours.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**Global Service Delivery and SLA Management**

* Lead the daily operation of the global GMP documentation service for DS, DP, or FDP, ensuring requests are received, clarified, prioritized, assigned, completed, and handed off in accordance with defined service-level agreements.
* Establish transparent intake, triage, prioritization, and escalation practices that balance site criticality, compliance risk, business impact, and available capacity.
* Develop and maintain capacity plans, workload forecasts, staffing models, and recovery plans that enable the team to meet commitments across supported sites and time zones.
* Own performance management routines and dashboards for on-time delivery, right-first-time quality, cycle time, queue aging, rework, customer feedback, and resource utilization.
* Identify service risks early, communicate impacts and options clearly, and escalate constraints with proposed mitigation and recovery actions.

**GMP Documentation Quality and Compliance**

* Ensure document creation and revision activities comply with applicable global and local GMP requirements, good documentation practices, data-integrity expectations, controlled-document procedures, and approved change-control processes.
* Set and maintain standards for document structure, technical writing, accuracy, traceability, version control, formatting, and review readiness to prevent defects before delivery.
* Oversee authoring and revision of controlled GMP documents, such as SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing and laboratory records, technical reports, and associated attachments, based on approved site inputs and change requirements.
* Oversee the content creation of training materials used in the manufacturing areas including instructional design.
* Implement appropriate peer review, quality checks, training, and escalation mechanisms to improve right-first-time acceptance and reduce avoidable rework.
* Support inspection and audit readiness; ensure service records, training, and performance evidence are complete, traceable, and review-ready.
* Oversee investigational support within the specific manufacturing domain.

**Global Partnership and Governance**

* Serve as the senior-manager-level liaison between the India documentation team and global site stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, QC, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and other technical functions.
* Create effective governance forums with supported sites to review demand, priorities, service performance, quality trends, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.
* Clarify and maintain accountability between the service team and site owners: the service team provides disciplined document development and revision support; site functions retain ownership of technical content, approvals, local requirements, and implementation decisions.
* Resolve complex cross-functional issues that could affect document quality, approval readiness, delivery timing, or compliance, using a risk-based approach.

**People Leadership and Organizational Capability**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing team of GMP documentation professionals, technical writers, and/or documentation specialists.
* Establish role clarity, training curricula, performance expectations, career paths, and succession plans that build sustainable technical and leadership capability in India.
* Promote a culture of quality, ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning while maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and accountable work environment.
* Partner with Human Resources and functional leaders to maintain an adaptable organization that can respond to changing global demand and business priorities.

**Operational Excellence and Strategic Improvement**

* Standardize and continuously improve documentation workflows, templates, authoring practices, quality controls, and digital ways of working across the service.
* Lead cross-site projects and improvement initiatives that increase speed, accuracy, scalability, and customer experience without compromising compliance.
* Manage departmental headcount, training, technology, and operating budgets; optimize resources against the long-range demand plan.
* Represent the documentation service on global teams, task forces, and quality-system initiatives as needed.

Service Performance and Quality Measures
  
  
The leader establishes goals and management routines that keep customer commitments, documentation quality, and compliance visible and balanced.
  
  
**Measure**
**Leadership expectation**
**On-time delivery**
Meet committed site service-level agreements through active planning, workload balancing, and early escalation of risks.
  
  
**Right-first-time quality**
Increase documents accepted without material rework by applying defined authoring standards, peer review, and quality checks before handoff.
  
  
**Cycle time and queue health**
Monitor turnaround time, aging, backlog, and prioritization to maintain a predictable global service.
  
  
**Compliance performance**
Maintain adherence to controlled-document, change-control, data-integrity, training, and audit-readiness requirements.
  
  
**Customer partnership and capacity**
Use site feedback, demand forecasts, and workload data to improve service reliability and plan resource needs.
  
  
*Service-level targets and acceptance criteria are defined in collaboration with the supported sites and governing quality processes.*
**Basic Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree and 12 to 17 years of experience
  
  
2 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation of resources.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, technical communications, business, or a related field.
* 7+ years of directly related experience in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical-device, or other regulated GMP environment, including 4+ years leading people, technical writers, documentation specialists, projects, or programs.
* Demonstrated experience developing and revising controlled GMP documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing or laboratory records, and related technical documentation.
* Experience operating a shared service or customer-facing function across multiple sites, cultures, and time zones, with accountability for service-level agreements and delivery metrics.
* Experience with electronic document-management and quality-management systems, document lifecycles, change control, and inspection or audit support.
* Lean, continuous-improvement, project-management, or operational-excellence experience is preferred.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strong people leadership, coaching, talent development, and capability building for a diverse technical team.
* Expert technical writing, editing, and review skills; sound judgment to distinguish content clarity, document quality, and compliance risk.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, good documentation practices, data integrity principles, controlled-document requirements, and change-management processes.
* Service-management discipline: intake, prioritization, workload planning, capacity modeling, performance dashboards, and timely risk escalation.
* Ability to influence global stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and operate effectively across time zones.
* Analytical problem solving, continuous-improvement mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage change without compromising quality while demonstrating a commitment to safety, quality, integrity, and Amgen values.

description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

The Senior Change Management Analyst is an experienced individual contributor responsible for supporting ITIL-aligned IT change management. Reporting to the Change Manager, the role reviews and coordinates Requests for Change (RFCs), prepares CAB materials, maintains the change calendar, validates implementation readiness, supports stakeholder communications, monitors outcomes, and recommends continual improvements. The role does not own enterprise change policy, manage people, or serve as final approver for high-risk changes unless formally delegated.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support consistent, ITIL-aligned execution of the change process under direction of the Change Manager.
* Review RFCs for completeness, risk, impact, approvals, testing evidence, implementation steps, validation criteria, communications, and rollback planning.
* Coordinate with change owners, technical teams, service owners, release teams, incident management, vendors.
* Maintain accurate change records, calendar entries, meeting notes, decision logs, and audit-ready evidence. Escalate scheduling conflicts, readiness gaps, policy exceptions, high-risk changes, and change-related incidents.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Change Governance and RFC Quality**

* Apply approved change policies, procedures, templates, workflows, risk models, and approval paths in daily change activities.
* Review RFCs for business justification, scope, affected services, dependencies, outage needs, approvals, implementation, validation, and backout plans.
* Return incomplete or unclear records to change owners and document required corrections according to process guidelines.
* Verify correct classification and routing for standard, normal, emergency, expedited, major, minor, vendor release-related, infrastructure, application, cloud, security, and vendor-driven changes.

**CAB and Change Meeting Support**

* Prepare CAB agendas, change summaries, risk highlights, schedule views, meeting materials, and decision documentation.
* Assist the Change Manager with facilitation, timekeeping, risk callouts, notes, follow-up tracking, deferrals, approvals, and action items.
* Escalate high-risk, high-impact, conflicting, business-critical, or poorly documented changes before CAB review.

**Risk, Impact, and Readiness Assessment**

* Evaluate readiness based on service impact, technical complexity, outage duration, customer impact, security exposure, data sensitivity, dependencies, and rollback feasibility.
* Constructively challenge weak implementation plans, inadequate testing evidence, incomplete dependency analysis, missing communications, or unrealistic rollback steps.
* Escalate unresolved concerns, policy exceptions, and changes requiring additional review by service owners, cybersecurity, compliance, release management, or business stakeholders.

**Calendar, Scheduling, and Communications**

* Maintain the enterprise change calendar and monitor maintenance windows, blackout periods, and resource constraints.
* Identify collisions, overlapping outages, resource conflicts, and competing implementation windows; coordinate schedule alignment with release, project, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, vendor, and operations teams.
* Draft and distribute approved communications; ensure service desk and support teams understand outage windows, expected symptoms, business impact, workarounds, and escalation contacts.

**Emergency Change, PIR, Metrics, and Tooling**

* Support emergency changes by verifying urgency, risk, approvals, implementation details, validation, communications, and after-the-fact documentation.
* Support post-implementation reviews for failed, backed-out, emergency, high-risk, major, or incident-causing changes; document lessons learned, corrective actions, owners, due dates, and follow-up status.
* Prepare dashboards, trend summaries, audit evidence, and KPI reporting for success rate, failed changes, emergency volume, unauthorized changes, change-related incidents, approval cycle time, standard adoption, and CAB action closure.
* Use ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit changes; recommend workflow, notification, dashboard, template, and automation improvements.

**YOUR PROFILE**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5 or more years in IT service management, IT operations, infrastructure support, application support, release management, project coordination, or production support.
* 3 or more years of hands-on experience supporting an enterprise IT change management process.
* Current ITIL certification required, preferably ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Experience reviewing RFCs, maintaining change calendars, preparing CAB materials, supporting emergency changes, and documenting post-implementation review outcomes.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or comparable ITSM platforms.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices, including change enablement, incident, problem, service request, configuration, release, service level, and continual improvement.
* Ability to translate technical information into business impact, risk, operational readiness, and stakeholder communication requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for meeting notes, status updates, process documentation, and stakeholder communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 Practitioner: Change Enablement.
* Experience in regulated or audit-driven environments such as Financial Services.
* Experience supporting cloud, hybrid infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, application, database, endpoint, and enterprise platform changes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and automated change approval models.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC1, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar control frameworks.
* Experience creating dashboards and analytics using ServiceNow Performance Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting standard change models, risk scoring frameworks, process training materials, and stakeholder communication templates.

**Required Technical Skills And Core Competencies**

* ITSM and Change: ITIL-aligned workflows, RFC quality, classifications, approvals, calendars, risk assessment, and closure.
* Risk Judgment: Identifies service, business, technical, security, compliance, and scheduling risks before implementation.
* Service Tools: Use ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit change records.
* Process Discipline: Applies governance consistently while keeping the process practical and understandable.
* Technology Ops: Working knowledge of infrastructure, applications, networks, databases, cloud, cybersecurity, endpoints, and production support.
* Accountability: Follows up, maintains accurate records, meets deadlines, and escalates unresolved risks properly.
* Reporting: Create and interpret dashboards, KPI summaries, trend reports, data quality checks, and audit evidence.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Builds effective relationships across technical teams, service owners, vendors, audit, and business stakeholders.
* Documentation: Create clear meeting notes, change summaries, process guidance, work instructions, and communications.
* Communication: Explains technical change activity clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaboration Tools:Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Visio, or equivalent tools.
* Continuous Improvement: Simplifies workflows, standardizes repeatable work, improves templates, and reduces rework.

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression

description:

This role supports the quality and effectiveness of Amgen’s warehousing processes by maintaining controlled documents, coordinating defined business continuity and training activities, and collaborating with stakeholders across regions. * Coordinate stakeholder input, document comments and required approvals for assigned documents, and escalate unresolved issues or decisions to the BPO.

* Participate in corporate function audits of the Warehousing and Distribution quality process as requested.

**Warehouse Global Business Continuity Plan**

* Support the review and revision of the Warehouse Global Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and related Business Impact Analysis (BIA).
* Collect and consolidate input from process and site stakeholders and coordinate assigned follow-up actions with the Business Continuity Team.
* Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation for assigned business continuity activities.

**Global Warehousing Training**

* Develop and maintain assigned training content, learning activities, training qualifications and Assignment Vehicles for Global Warehousing processes and systems.
* Act as designated author, editor or administrator for assigned training documents and records in CDOCS and the Learning Management System (LMS), in accordance with approved governance.
* Coordinate the creation, revision and implementation of assigned Learning Activities and Assignment Vehicles with the process owner and Learning & Performance (L&P).
* Collect data and stakeholder feedback to support assessment of training effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain functions and qualified instructors to support timely training delivery.
* Monitor assigned training actions and escalate risks, gaps or overdue items to the responsible owner.

**Stakeholder Collaboration and Improvement**

* Maintain effective working relationships with Warehouse Network stakeholders, Quality, Learning & Performance and Global Distribution.
* Facilitate defined process-documentation or training workshops using established methods and templates.
* Analyze process feedback, document issues and training data to identify improvement opportunities and prepare recommendations for review.
* Plan and deliver assigned activities within agreed timelines, communicating progress, dependencies and risks to the manager or process owner.
* Share lessons learned and reusable materials across the Warehouse Network.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in supply chain, logistics, economics or a related discipline with total 5 to 9 years of experience.
* 2+ years of supply chain, logistics, warehousing, quality systems, document management or related experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated environment.
* At minimum basic GMP knowledge and experience.
* Basic knowledge of ERP and WMS systems, preferably SAP (E)WM.
* Experience documenting business processes, process flows, SOPs, WIs or other Quality Management System documents.
* Experience working with Quality Management Systems and controlled-document processes.
* Working knowledge of business process modelling; experience with Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) is preferred.
* Technical writing skills and strong attention to detail.
* Ability to facilitate structured workshops and coordinate input from cross-functional and geographically diverse stakeholders.
* Interest in learning and development methods, including e-learning; LMS experience is preferred.
* Ability to work independently on defined assignments, manage priorities and escalate matters outside assigned scope.
* Experience working in a matrix-based organization and collaborating within a network.
* Fluency in English in oral and written communication.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

Role Scope and Decision-Making
  
  

* Works within established global processes, quality requirements, governance and priorities.
* Owns the quality and timely completion of assigned deliverables, but not the overall Global Warehousing process, training strategy or business continuity framework.
* Makes routine decisions within assigned document, training and coordination activities and escalates significant compliance, scope or stakeholder decisions to the accountable owner.
* May coordinate contributors for defined activities but has no formal people-management accountability.

The Asistant Manager
**,**
