description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
Background
  
  
Alter Domus is one of the world’s leading users of real estate fund accounting software, servicing 26 of the 30 largest real estate firms globally from offices across over 20 countries. Due to continuing growth we are looking for an additional Implementation Support Officer for our Yardi real estate platform.
  
  
The Officer is responsible for delivering the migration of data for newly won business of existing real estate investment funds onto the Alter Domus platforms, under supervision of Senior officer or Manager. This includes co-ordinating with other internal and external stakeholders in the process such as the client, accounting teams, and third-party service providers. The Officer acts as a bridge between the operational/accounting teams and the system/technical team, able to understand the requirements of both sides and drive effective collaboration.
  
  
An ideal candidate has strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and is comfortable with working on multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  
  
They will also be comfortable explaining technical concepts to stakeholders.
  
  
This role suits someone who is a self-starter, quick learner, capable of grasping new concepts quickly and consistently delivers results in a client-focused culture.
  
  
A good level of excel skills, accounting background (A Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting or 1-2 years of accounting experience) and attention to detail are key.
  
  
Yardi software knowledge is an asset but not mandatory.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Deliver client implementation and data migration projects to completion according to project plans, under the direction of a senior officer or manager;
* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the tools and resources needed to meet deliverables;
* Have a delivery role in Yardi implementations, including the set-up of funds in the system, migration of data from external sources, and gathering of requirements for custom reporting;
* Coach and support operations team members in the best practice use of the system and adoption of new functionality.

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave

* Continuous mentoring along your career progression

* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Operations Consultant
description:
**Role: Operations Consultant**

**Who We Are:**

Streamliners is a management consulting firm specialized in rapid efficiency improvements, operational excellence, and fast turnaround. We help manufacturers and private equity owned portfolio companies in North America and Europe solve complex operational challenges to maximize profit margins and gain competitive advantage. At our core, we are doers. We work closely with clients in various industries to execute the steps required to achieve performance improvements.

**Who You Are:**

A experienced and self-directed problem solver. A change management champion. You not only work well with others, but also can operate autonomously with little direction. You go the extra mile, and your entrepreneurial drive and intellectual curiosity have helped you garner a track-record of achievement.

You should feel second nature conducting & leading the following analysis:

* Process Capacity & Utilization Modeling
* Bottleneck Analysis
* Waste Reduction
* Warehouse Restructuring
* KPI Creation
* Root Cause Analysis
* Workforce Analysis

**The Role:**

You will work alongside other consultants and clients, typically on site, to deliver transformation objectives. You will have ownership of workstreams and be responsible for executing effective improvement plans within operations, ranging from shop floor improvements to fundamental changes in work processes and information and material flows. You’ll also serve clients in a project manager capacity for turnarounds, transformations, and expansions.

**Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Serve as project leader for project workstreams, transformations, and turnarounds
* Problem-solve technical manufacturing issues using structured methodologies
* Use facts and data to prioritize improvement opportunities
* You will adopt a process-oriented approach to solving problems and will break a large complex problem into a series of smaller, more manageable modules.
* Drive change and improvements to the overall execution of client operations
* Transform manufacturing processes for better productivity and efficiency
* Conduct due diligence, benchmarking, best practice, and other assessment studies
* Recommend actions and help clients implement them
* Manage and deliver the highest quality client work

**Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience in a high-performance manufacturing environment
* 3+ years leadership and management experience
* Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics), Operations, or Business
* Strong functional knowledge in one or more of the following: discrete manufacturing, project management, process automation, continuous improvement
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with people at all levels in an organization
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* **Willingness to travel to US and Europe 2 or 3 months in year**

**Preferred:**

* Background in Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt is a plus) and methodologies including but not limited to Kaizen methods, JIT, Kanban, SMED, 5S, Poka Yoke, Visual Workplace, and VSM
* Experience in management consulting, large-scale change management, or turnaround and restructurings
* Direct operating experience with P&L accountability
* International work experience

title: Consultant- Industrialization Quality Engineer
description:
Our client, a leading global specialist in energy management and automation, is seeking an experienced Industrialization Quality Engineer to lead quality activities for new product introductions and industrialization projects, ensuring APQP compliance, launch readiness, risk mitigation, and adherence to quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

**Industrialization Quality & New Product Launch Excellence**

* Drive and monitor Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities for new product development and industrialization projects.
* Support successful New Product Introduction (NPI) and offer creation activities from concept through production launch. (Optional)
* Ensure adherence to Offer Lifecycle Management (OLM) industrial processes and governance requirements.
* Support quality readiness reviews and validation activities to ensure flawless, on-time product launches.
* Collaborate with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Project Teams, Squads, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to identify and mitigate quality risks.
* Participate in design reviews and industrialization gates to ensure product and process quality requirements are met.
* Support deployment and closure of product and process quality actions prior to launch.
* Ensure implementation and effectiveness of quality tools such as PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Validation, and PPAP.

* Manage daily industrialization quality activities in coordination with project teams and Cross Functional Teams (CFTs).
* Support CFT members to achieve quality targets and business objectives.

* Support escalation management and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor project quality KPIs and ensure timely achievement of launch milestones.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve product quality, process capability, and operational efficiency.
* Promote a culture of quality, customer focus, and continuous learning across the organization.

Skills Required

**Key Competencies**

**Technical Competencies**

* APQP / PPAP
* New Product Introduction (NPI)
* Industrialization & Manufacturing Quality
* Quality Fundamentals Deployment
* Risk Management (PFMEA, Control Plans)
* SPC, Gauge R&R and MSA
* Process Validation & Quality Planning
* Root Cause Analysis & Problem Solving
* Product Launch Management
* Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 preferred)
* Statistical Process Control (SPC)

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Team Leadership
* Stakeholder Management
* Decision Making
* Communication & Influencing Skills
* Analytical Thinking
* Customer Focus
* Continuous Improvement Mindset
* Result Orientation

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related discipline).
* Postgraduate qualification in Quality Management or Operations Management is an added advantage.

**Experience Requirements**

* 4–8 years of experience in Manufacturing Quality, Industrialization Quality, Product Quality, or New Product Introduction (NPI).
* Proven experience in leading APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plan, and product launch quality activities.
* Experience working in cross-functional and global project environments.
* Strong knowledge of industrialization processes, manufacturing systems, and quality management methodologies.
* Experience in driving quality improvements and launch readiness activities in manufacturing organizations.

**Success Measures**

* Right First-Time Product Launches.
* APQP and OLM Compliance.

title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**

EB1A Experts supports tech professionals in building strong evidence strategies and clear personal narratives for employment-based immigration paths such as EB1A, O1A, and EB2-NIW. The team specializes in transforming dispersed achievements across roles, projects, and recognitions into cohesive, compelling stories of influence, leadership, and impact. By identifying persuasive proof points and organizing supporting materials with intention, EB1A Experts helps clients present structured and credible cases. The company focuses on clarity, ensuring each client’s journey is accurately reflected through narrative and evidence. EB1A Experts provides educational and informational guidance and does not offer legal advice or representation before U.S. immigration authorities.

**Role Summary**

This role is responsible for researching, writing, and submitting scholarly articles to peer-reviewed journals. The writer develops manuscripts across technical and professional fields, identifies journals whose scope and standards match each article, and guides each manuscript through peer review to publication.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Research and write original, well-structured scholarly articles (research papers, review articles, case studies, and perspective pieces) across technical and professional fields.

• Research technical topics in depth and translate complex concepts and data into clear, accurate scholarly writing.

• Review journal aims & scope, author guidelines, and recently published work to assess suitability, and tailor each manuscript to the target journal's structure, style, and citation requirements.

• Conduct literature reviews using academic databases (e.g., Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore) and cite sources accurately.

• Prepare complete submission packages, including cover letters, abstracts, keywords, figures and tables, declarations, and supporting documents.

• Submit manuscripts through journal submission platforms (e.g., Editorial Manager, ScholarOne) and track their status through to a decision.

• Respond to editor and reviewer comments, revise manuscripts, and prepare clear point-by-point response letters.

• Ensure originality and uphold publication-ethics standards, including plagiarism screening and proper attribution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

• Prior experience writing and publishing in peer-reviewed journals, with published papers as evidence (first-author or co-author).

• Master's degree or higher in a technical, scientific, engineering, business, or related discipline (M.Phil/Masters preferred). Candidates with a bachelor's degree and a strong publication record will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of the academic journal ecosystem: aims & scope, peer review, article types, indexing databases, and journal metrics.

• Technical aptitude: able to understand and accurately explain technical concepts across areas such as engineering, computing, data science, life sciences, or business.

• Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to adapt tone and structure to different disciplines and journals.

• Proficiency with reference managers (e.g., Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote) and plagiarism-checking tools (e.g., Turnitin, iThenticate).

• Strong attention to detail, time management, and the ability to handle multiple manuscripts at different stages concurrently.

**Preferred (Not Required)**

• Experience publishing across more than one discipline.

• Prior experience as a scientific or technical writer, journal editor, or peer reviewer.

• Familiarity with LaTeX and journal-specific manuscript templates.

* Customer Empathy: Exceptional listening, patience, and written/verbal communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating frustrated clients.
* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).
* Preferred: basic technical literacy (familiarity with API logs, SQL, or web technologies) to effectively communicate tradeoffs with engineering teams.

description:

**Who are we:**

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Global Job Profile: ECM Service Manager**

**About Us (Enterprise Content Management - ECM)**

We provide our Business Partners with a reliable and comprehensive service for capturing, managing, storing, preserving and retrieving business content and documents that are key to their business functions. We offer two solutions:

· ECMaaS: is a shared content services platform using primarily IBM Cloud Pack for Business Automation (CP4BA) and hosted in Capgemini Azure Cloud.

· ZBOX: is a shared content services platform based on Box SaaS

We offer from Consulting Services, to Project execution and application maintenance for the above shared ECM platforms.

**Your Role:**

As a Service Manager for ECM shared platforms, you’ll play a crucial role in maintaining and evolving our ECMaaS and ZBOX business-critical applications, with focus on APAC region.

You would be the main contact person for our APAC clients and you’ll be empowered to make decisions, collaborate globally, ensuring stability and reliability for thousand of users.

Your main responsibilities would be:

* ECM Service Manager for ECMaaS APAC applications
* ECM Service Manager for ZBOX APAC applications

* Manage ECMaaS and ZBOX small-medium work orders, and support other large platform projects (i.e Platform Upgrades, etc) if required.
* Administer ZBOX APAC applications.

You’ll work with colleagues who are both proactive and genuinely supportive, fostering an environment where teamwork and shared success are at the core of our ways of working. Your responsibility can grow in line with the value you bring and your proactive approach—meaning your ideas, initiative, and drive are recognized and rewarded. We value your expertise, support your growth, and trust you with responsibilities that matter.

This is an individual Contributor (IC) role, where you will expected to work as an independent contributor, taking ownership of service delivery, driving operational excellence, and collaborating with several Zurich teams and third party vendors to ensure stable and reliable platform operations.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Oversee the delivery of high-quality IT support services to our internal stakeholders, ensuring we meet service level agreements (SLAs) and maintain a stable production environment. Also play a key role in managing changes, security, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead management communications for the business for service (e.g. incident alerts, change freezes etc.), as well as escalations, and demand (new opportunities).
* Manage small-medium work orders, and support other large platform projects (i.e Platform Upgrades, etc).
* Prepare monthly reporting and handle monthly service reviews with the business unit counterparts
* Identify service improvement actions and work with the required parties for the implementation of the same.
* Identify and implement continuous improvements to our support processes and tools.
* Work with the business unit and Global Disaster Recovery teams to ensure that the disaster recovery capability meets the global DR requirements, including planning, performance of testing, communication and restoration of services in response to a major outage or disaster.
* Ensure internal and external providers are compliant with regulatory requirements and provide assistance and support for audits, where applicable.
* Drive daily use of Zurich approved AI tools and accelerators to support daily activities (e.g., requirements review, summaries or analyze historical incident tickets, simplify reporting, detects outdated documentation, identify components with high change sensitivity, etc).
* Ensure that the ZBOX applications in the region are up and running. This includes raising support tickets with the Box partner when an incidents originates from the Box SaaS solution itself.

**Required experience & certificates:**

* The ideal ECM Service Manager should hold an ITIL Service Management level qualification and possess advanced English skills, both written and verbal.
* A minimum of three years' service delivery experience is essential, with additional experience in project management—particularly managing small to medium work orders—being preferred.

**Technical skills:**

* IT educational background
* Good understanding of cloud hosting technologies (Azure).
* Knowledge of Content Management systems (FileNet, Box, SharePoint…) is an advantage
* Ability to configure and manage IT tools
* Knowledge on tools such as Microsoft office, and other potential administrator tools like box CLI or similar.

**Soft Skills:**

* The role requires proven ability to work effectively in diverse, multi-cultural environments, demonstrating adaptability in the face of ambiguity and evolving requirements.
* Strong communication skills are necessary to interact with both business and technical stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* The role requires accuracy and attention to detail.
* Proactively identifies opportunities to enhance processes, tools, and ways of working.
* Drives the successful delivery of initiatives by translating plans into concrete actions.
* Demonstrates a strong customer-centric mindset, anticipating and responding effectively to stakeholders’ needs.
* End-to-end accountability.
* Problem-solving attitude.
* Service-oriented mindset.
* Hands-on attitude and willingness to proactively tackle tasks are crucial for success in this position.

With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The
**Service Improvement Analyst – Digital Workplace Services**
is responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and driving service improvement opportunities across the Digital Workplace Services portfolio. This role focuses on enhancing the end-user experience, improving service performance, optimizing operational processes, and increasing adoption of modern workplace technologies.
  
  
Leveraging
**ITIL, Lean Six Sigma (LSS), Continual Service Improvement (CSI), and Digital Employee Experience (DEX)**
principles, the analyst partners with service owners, engineering teams, operations teams, vendors, and clients to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and measure outcomes. The role requires a strong combination of analytical skills, customer focus, business acumen, and technical understanding of modern workplace services such as Microsoft 365, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, service desk operations, and end-user computing services.
  
  
The Service Improvement Analyst will lead improvement initiatives across multiple clients and business functions while ensuring service delivery aligns with business objectives, user expectations, and operational excellence standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Improvement & Digital Workplace Optimization
  
  

* Lead the development and execution of service improvement initiatives across Digital Workplace Services in partnership with Service Excellence Leads, Service Owners, Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Analyze service performance, user experience data, operational metrics, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive continual improvement programs focused on enhancing employee productivity, service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Establish improvement roadmaps aligned with Digital Workplace Services strategy and business objectives.
* Support the adoption and optimization of workplace technologies including Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, endpoint services, mobility solutions, and digital employee experience tools.
* Utilize Digital Employee Experience (DEX) insights, service analytics, and user sentiment data to prioritize and implement service improvements.

Process Excellence & Operational Effectiveness
  
  

* Develop a thorough understanding of existing Digital Workplace processes, workflows, and service delivery models to identify optimization opportunities.
* Create and maintain operational process documentation including: Process maps and flowcharts Standard operating procedures (SOPs) Capacity and utilization studies Time and motion studies Standard work documentation Cycle-time and workflow analysis
* Lead process redesign initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, standardization, and service quality.
* Coordinate and track improvement activities resulting from Kaizen workshops, problem-solving sessions, and operational reviews.
* Implement Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, and Continuous Improvement methodologies to drive measurable outcomes.

Analytics, Reporting & Insights
  
  

* Define, monitor, and report on key Digital Workplace Services KPIs and SLAs, including: Service Desk performance End-user experience metrics Incident and request trends Availability and reliability metrics Adoption and utilization metrics Customer satisfaction (CSAT) Employee experience measures
* Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Conduct root cause analysis and trend analysis to proactively address recurring service issues.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making to recommend service enhancements and operational improvements.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-functional service improvement initiatives involving Operations, Engineering, Service Management, Product Teams, Vendors, and Client stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and point of contact for service improvement programs and transformation efforts.
* Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and continuous improvement sessions with business and technical teams.
* Deliver Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, Continual Improvement, and service management training and awareness sessions.
* Mentor Yellow and Green Belt practitioners and support the organization's continuous improvement culture.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize and implement approved improvements that increase service value, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

Governance & Best Practices
  
  

* Promote and enforce ITIL and continual improvement best practices across Digital Workplace Services.
* Support service governance activities, operational reviews, and improvement boards.
* Ensure improvement initiatives are measured, documented, and sustained through appropriate governance and change management practices.
* Drive the identification, adoption, and continuous improvement of scalable end-to-end service delivery processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Service Improvement, Process Improvement, Business Analysis, Service Management, or a related role.
* 2+ years of experience applying Lean Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence methodologies.
* Experience supporting or improving Digital Workplace Services environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven track record of identifying improvement opportunities and delivering measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience documenting and optimizing business and operational processes.
* Experience working cross-functionally within complex organizational environments.
* Ability to effectively collaborate with global and remote teams.
* Excellent reporting, dashboard creation, and performance measurement experience.
* Strong verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Teams, and Visio.
* Strong understanding of service management principles, KPIs, SLAs, and operational metrics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher-level ITIL certification.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms such as Nexthink, Lakeside, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Endpoint Management, Intune, Windows Services, Collaboration Platforms, and Modern Workplace technologies.
* Experience with Power BI, ServiceNow, and service analytics platforms.
* Experience in managed services or enterprise IT environments.

You are energized by a fast-paced environment and are passionate about providing world-class support through phone, email, and chat, ready to tackle any challenge that comes your way, including participation in a rotating on-call schedule to provide critical support.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality, real-time technical support to customers via phone, email, and chat, managing multiple issues simultaneously.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and tune AI systems to ensure chatbot and voice bot interactions remain highly accurate and effective for credit union members.
* Explain complex AI functionalities, configurations, and system options directly to clients to ensure they maximize the value of our platform.
* Identify AI product bugs and anomalies, clearly articulating the underlying technical issues and their direct client impact to Product and Engineering teams.
* Act as an internal AI subject matter expert, creating documentation and passing along your specialized knowledge to upscale the rest of the support team.
* Lead technical troubleshooting sessions with customer IT teams, diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to networking (VPNs, firewalls, whitelisting), cloud infrastructure (AWS), and integrated phone systems.
* Utilize Zendesk to manage, prioritize, and document customer support tickets from initial contact through to resolution.
* Analyze application, server, and AI logs to identify performance bottlenecks and root causes of failures.
* Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to provide after-hours and weekend support for critical, service-impacting incidents.
* Develop and maintain internal and customer-facing support documentation, including knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of experience in a technical support role for an Enterprise SaaS product.
* Proven experience working with or supporting AI/Automation technologies (e.g., Natural Language Processing, Chatbots, Voice bots, or AI-driven analytics).

**Technical Proficiency**

* Deep understanding of how AI systems work, including intent tuning, conversational flows, and AI training methodologies.
* Experience analyzing and troubleshooting AI-driven chatbots, voice bots, and data analytics tools.
* Strong hands-on experience with Zendesk for ticketing and customer support.
* Deep understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and protocols like SFTP and HTTPS.
* Proven experience working with cloud environments, specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., Lex, Connect, EC2, S3, VPC).
* Familiarity with troubleshooting VoIP/telephony systems and understanding common communication routing issues.

**Core Skills**

* Exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a passion for tackling complex AI and technical challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage high-priority tasks, and perform effectively under pressure.
* Experience with log analysis tools (e.g., Kibana, CloudWatch) and network traffic analysis tools (e.g., Fiddler, Wireshark).
* Ability to remain organized and detail-oriented while managing a high volume of support interactions.
* Must be willing and able to participate in a rotating on-call schedule.

**Why join us?**

* Be part of a dynamic, high-growth tech company with an exciting future.
* Work in a collaborative and supportive environment that values innovation and employee experience.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including healthcare, 401(k), and professional development opportunities.
* An opportunity to make a direct impact in shaping peoples direct access to financial services by enabling community financial institutions to efficiently communicate with their membership base.

**About Eltropy (www.eltropy.com)**
Eltropy is on a mission to disrupt the way people access financial services. Eltropy enables financial institutions to digitally engage in a secure and compliant way. Using our world-class digital communications platform, community financial institutions can improve operations, engagement and productivity. CFIs (Community Banks and Credit Unions) use Eltropy to communicate with consumers via Text, Video, Secure Chat, co-browsing, screen sharing and chatbot technology — all integrated in a single platform bolstered by AI, skill-based routing and other contact center capabilities.

title: Change and CMDB Coordinator
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
**Purpose of the role**
The Change Coordinator is the hands-on operator of the change management process, running the day-to-day flow of changes through Jira Service Management under the direction of the Change Manager. The role keeps changes moving: logging and quality-checking requests, coordinating risk assessment, scheduling, chasing approvals, sending deployment notifications, and driving each change to closure.
  
  
Where the Change Manager owns policy, authority and governance, the Coordinator owns execution and momentum. It is a highly organised, detail-focused, delivery-oriented role and the first point of contact for change requesters. The Coordinator prepares and services the CAB but does not chair it or hold final authorisation authority.
  
  
**Scope**

* Day-to-day operation of the change management process for infrastructure, cloud (AWS) and production changes recorded in JSM (KEYCAB project).
* The change calendar / forward schedule of change, deployment windows and change-related communications.
* Preparation, coordination and minuting of CAB and ECAB meetings.
* Accurate, up-to-date change records and status through the JSM workflow.
* Day-to-day coordination of the infrastructure CMDB — keeping CI records accurate and changes linked to the CIs they affect.

**Key Responsibilities**
Logging & quality control
  
  

* Receive and log CAB Requests; check each for completeness — description, reason, risk, rollback plan, testing evidence and impact.
* Return incomplete requests to requesters and coach them on what good looks like.
* Ensure each change is correctly categorised (standard / minor / major / emergency) with the Change Manager where needed.

Coordination & scheduling
  
  

* Maintain the forward schedule of change; book deployment windows and flag clashes, dependencies and freeze periods.
* Chase and track technical approval (Tech Lead) and change approval (Senior PM); ensure approvals are recorded before deployment.
* Coordinate the parties involved in each change and confirm readiness ahead of the window.

Communication
  
  

* Prepare and issue deployment notifications to the relevant distribution lists ahead of each change.
* Keep stakeholders informed of schedule, status and any changes or slips.
* Act as day-to-day point of contact for change requesters and implementers.

CAB support
  
  

* Build the CAB agenda, circulate the change list, and prepare supporting information for the Change Manager (chair).
* Take minutes, record decisions and actions, and follow up to completion.
* Coordinate the ECAB for emergency changes at short notice.

CMDB coordination (infrastructure)
  
  

* Maintain infrastructure configuration item (CI) records in the CMDB — creating, updating and retiring CIs as changes are delivered.
* Link each change to the CIs it affects so impact assessment and reporting stay accurate.
* Run routine CMDB housekeeping: spot gaps, duplicates and stale records, and support audit and reconciliation activity under the Change Manager.
* Escalate CMDB data-quality issues and model changes to the Change Manager.

Tracking, closure & records
  
  

* Progress each CAB Request through the JSM statuses — Assess & Evaluate, approvals, Approved for Deployment, In Progress, Post-Deployment Validation, closed.
* Confirm post-deployment validation (health checks) is recorded and chase outstanding closures.
* Capture post-implementation review notes and lessons learned; maintain accurate, auditable records.
* Produce routine change reports and metrics extracts for the Change Manager.

**Authority & boundaries**

* Authorised to log, categorise (with Manager), schedule and progress changes, and to hold changes that do not meet process requirements.
* Does not authorise major or emergency changes and does not chair the CAB — these sit with the Change Manager.
* Escalates contested, high-risk or non-compliant changes to the Change Manager.

**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
  
  
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
  
  
**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply**

title: Global Trial Acceleration Associate
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* The Global Trial Acceleration Associate is responsible for managing and executing on centralized activities in support of global trials with an emphasis on clinical documentation.
* The Global Trial Acceleration Associate will interact with clinical study sites, CROs/vendors, Country Trial Managers (CTM)/Clinical Trial Monitor (CTMo.), the study team and other functional areas within BMS and will provide support to the Study Team throughout the study duration (start-up, maintenance, and close-out of clinical studies).
* As the main point of contact for essential document management, ethical and regulatory submission-related activities, develops and maintains collaborative working relationships with relevant stakeholders.
* Support outsourcing activities by interfacing with operational teams, support groups and service providers for successful selection, contracting and execution of outsourced studies while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, ethical practices, BMS outsourcing and procurement policies and procedures.
* Initiate and manage start-up documentation activities for global clinical trials.
* Submission of potential investigators to CTSS for debarment review and tracking of decisions.
* Responsible for country/Site Activation for clinical trials as applicable per region; this includes the final review of applicable documents, final sign-off of the country/site activation checklist. The incumbent may also be responsible for activating the site in accordance with all applicable global / local study procedures.
* May provide a level of quality control of start-up activity.
* Update and review of various study-related clinical systems to determine and report status of clinical trial documents for insourced studies (i.e., CTMS, eTMF, etc. or corresponding vendor systems)
* May arrange certified translation of study level documentation from translators as requested (i.e., ICF, Protocol, IB)
* May assist with the coordination or creation of other study specific materials such as pharmacy or Investigator site file to ensure that these are available on site for site initiation visits/prior to first patient visit.
* May act as single point of contact for the study team for centralized activities during study start-up.

This role is responsible for owning implementation delivery from scope definition through go-live, ensuring integrations are executed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with payments technology requirements.
  
  
The Implementation Manager operates as a client-facing individual contributor, combining project management, configuration expertise, technical analysis, and quality assurance to deliver successful customer implementations. This role requires close coordination with internal teams, external billers, and software partners.
  
  
**Success Profile**
At InvoiceCloud, success is anchored in our core competencies. These competencies guide how every employee delivers impact across their role.
  
  
**Ownership**

* Owns end-to-end delivery of assigned customer integrations, from scope analysis through go-live.

* Maintains proactive, transparent communication with customers and internal stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Takes responsibility for resolving issues, escalating risks appropriately, and ensuring commitments are met.

**Drives Efficiency**

* Analyzes integration scope and completes configuration questionnaires to ensure clear, complete implementation requirements.
* Configures systems within CRM and supporting platforms to meet integration specifications and business needs.
* Develops and executes delivery and project plans to ensure tasks are completed on time and dependencies are managed.
* Coordinates activities across IT, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Training, software partners, and billers to streamline go-live execution.

**Results Driven**

* Delivers integrations on schedule while meeting quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction expectations.
* Supports customer QA and UAT to validate configurations and resolve issues prior to launch.
* Submits and manages required Jira items, including integration coding and bill presentment requests, to ensure execution continuity.
* Ensures successful client go-lives through disciplined execution, testing, and stakeholder alignment.

**Innovative**

* Identifies opportunities to improve implementation workflows, documentation, and handoffs based on delivery experience.
* Collaborates with internal teams to refine configuration standards and reduce rework across implementations.
* Leverages automation and AI-enabled tools to support documentation, validation, and issue tracking during implementations.
* Continuously improves implementation practices to scale delivery as customer volume and integration complexity grow.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline
* 4–7 years of experience in implementation, project management, or a related role
* Experience supporting external clients with medium to advanced technical system implementations
* Experience configuring systems to integration specifications and supporting business requirements
* Strong understanding of testing, QA, and UAT processes
* Experience defining and executing delivery and project plans
* Experience working in a SaaS, fintech, or payments environment; insurance industry knowledge preferred
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize and multitask under deadlines
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel)
* Positive attitude, strong interpersonal skills, and willingness to learn

InvoiceCloud is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, nationality, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable laws.

title: Senior Knowledge Engineer, AI Enablement & Knowledge Systems
description:

As Customer Support continues evolving toward more AI-assisted, self-service, and agentic support experiences, you will help ensure knowledge is accurate, discoverable, trusted, and structured for both human and AI consumption. You will serve as the bridge between knowledge strategy, digital experiences, and AI enablement, ensuring knowledge is optimized to support scalable resolution across every support channel. Based on the evolution of AI and knowledge management within Customer Support, knowledge quality, governance, retrieval, and usability are increasingly foundational to AI effectiveness and support outcomes.

title: AI Knowledge Analyst I
description:
**Role Summary**
The AI Knowledge Analyst is a member of the Customer Care and Managed Services team, responsible for ensuring the knowledge ecosystems that power GHX's operations and AI platforms are accurate, well-governed, and continuously improving. This role works closely with leadership, SMEs, data scientists, and operational teams to identify content gaps, manage knowledge lifecycles, and translate business needs into structured, AI-ready information assets. The AI Knowledge Analyst is equally comfortable working through a detailed content audit and presenting a structured recommendation to leadership. Strong organizational skills, clear communication, and a bias for action are required. This is a role for someone who treats knowledge gaps as solvable problems and can move from gap identification to resolution with minimal direction.
  
  
**Core Focus Areas**
**Knowledge Governance & Lifecycle Management**
Maintain, organize, and govern the knowledge assets that support Customer Care and Managed Services teams. This includes managing intake, triage, and routing of knowledge requests; driving SME review cycles; and ensuring content is accurate, current, and ready for both human use and AI ingestion.
  
  
**AI Knowledge Readiness**
Identify, structure, and groom content that feeds GHX's AI platform. Partner with AI and data teams to ensure knowledge assets are formatted, accurate, and optimized for ingestion. Monitor AI solution performance and drive content improvements that translate into measurable efficiency gains.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Knowledge Management & Content Quality**

* Manage the intake, triage, and routing of knowledge-related requests from operational teams.
* Maintain content lifecycle through SME review checkpoints — flagging material for update, review, or archival on a consistent cadence.
* Identify obsolete, duplicate, or conflicting content and drive resolution through appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct knowledge audits and implement improvement cycles based on performance data and stakeholder feedback.
* Translate operational knowledge into structured, AI-ingestible formats ensuring accuracy, consistency, and taxonomy compliance.

**AI Knowledge Readiness & Technology**

* Structure and groom knowledge content for ingestion into GHX's AI platforms; ensure format, tagging, and taxonomy standards are met.
* Monitor AI platform performance related to knowledge quality; recommend and track content-driven improvements.
* Partner with data scientists and AI developers to understand ingestion requirements and close content gaps.
* Stay current on trends in AI knowledge management, large language model content requirements, and KM tooling.

**Process Improvement & Analysis**

* Analyze and document knowledge workflows, identifying gaps or structural issues that reduce content usability or AI accuracy.
* Interpret usage data, feedback trends, and engagement metrics to recommend improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation of governance standards, taxonomy structures, and documentation templates.
* Learn and apply Lean/Six Sigma and knowledge-centered service (KCS) frameworks where applicable.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with SMEs, operational leaders, and AI teams to promote adoption of AI-enabled knowledge systems.
* Provide end-user training and support on knowledge tools, systems, and updated content resources.
* Collect stakeholder requirements and develop content solutions that meet operational team needs.
* Present knowledge health findings and recommendations to leadership with clear next steps.

**Required Skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor message by audience.
* Familiarity with knowledge management systems (Confluence/Atlassian, Salesforce Knowledge, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret usage data and translate findings into action.
* Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple knowledge domains and adjust priorities as needed.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, SharePoint, Forms); CRM familiarity a plus (Salesforce preferred).
* Self-directed learner who identifies gaps and takes initiative to close them.
* Understanding of how content structure and taxonomy affect AI/ML model performance preferred.

**Education & Experience**

* 2+ years of related experience in knowledge management, operations enablement, content governance, or business analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining content for both human consumption (training, SOPs) and machine ingestion (AI platforms, knowledge bases).
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Management, Organizational Development, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Change management or KM certification (Prosci, KCS, ACMP) a plus.

title: End User Training Consultant
description:
**Blue Yonder Supply Chain Solutions**
Position Overview
  
  
The
**End User Training (EUT) Consultant**
is a client-facing learning and enablement professional who supports the design, development, and delivery of learning programs for Blue Yonder supply chain transformations. Working with Senior and Principal EUT Consultants, this role helps customers build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully adopt new technologies, processes, and ways of working.
  
  
The EUT Consultant combines
**instructional design, content development, facilitation, customer enablement, and consulting skills**
to translate business processes, system functionality, roles, and organizational impacts into practical, role-based learning experiences.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Support EUT activities and deliverables across enterprise supply chain transformation programs.
* Conduct and support learning discovery, stakeholder interviews, learning needs assessments, and role-based training analysis.
* Partner with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational processes, learner needs, and implementation requirements.
* Translate business processes, solution functionality, roles, and change impacts into learning objectives and role-based learning requirements.
* Support development of training plans, curricula, learning journeys, course outlines, content development plans, and training schedules.
* Design and develop instructor-led, virtual, blended, digital, and performance-support learning materials.
* Develop presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, scenarios, job aids, videos, assessments, and other learning resources.
* Customize learning content and examples to reflect customer business processes, use cases, roles, and implementation objectives.
* Apply adult learning, instructional design, learning experience, and content development best practices.
* Apply foundational Organizational Change Management principles to understand how business and role impacts, readiness, communications, and adoption influence learning requirements.
* Deliver instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, workshops, knowledge-transfer, and customer enablement sessions.
* Facilitate interactive and hands-on learning experiences aligned with customer use cases and operational processes.
* Adapt learning and facilitation approaches for different audiences, including business users, super users, system administrators, support teams, managers, and leaders.
* Support train-the-trainer, super-user enablement, instructor readiness, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Help customers build user proficiency, confidence, and greater self-sufficiency in using implemented solutions.
* Work with functional and solution experts to ensure learning accurately reflects configured solutions and future-state business processes.
* Participate in curriculum design, content review, validation, and training readiness sessions.
* Follow established content-development, quality, version-control, review, and approval processes.
* Work collaboratively with OCM, project management, Professional Services, solution, product, Customer Success, Education, and client teams to align learning with implementation milestones and business outcomes.
* Maintain EUT work plans, content trackers, review logs, and supporting project documentation.
* Support development of learning assessments and evaluation approaches and analyze learner feedback, training effectiveness, and adoption indicators.
* Use feedback, product enhancements, and implementation lessons learned to continuously improve learning content and delivery.
* Contribute lessons learned, templates, examples, best practices, and ideas that support continuous improvement and standardization of EUT methodologies and delivery assets.
* Develop knowledge of Blue Yonder solutions, supply chain processes, implementation methodologies, and enterprise transformation.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in end-user training, Learning & Development, instructional design, customer enablement, software implementation, professional services, or a related discipline.
* Experience designing and developing training content for enterprise software, SaaS platforms, business applications, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience delivering instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, or other facilitated learning experiences.
* Foundational knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, curriculum development, and training content development practices.
* Understanding of the relationship between Organizational Change Management, business readiness, learning, and end-user adoption.
* Ability to understand both business-process and technology concepts and translate complex information into clear, practical learning experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to establish effective working relationships with customers, subject matter experts, solution consultants, and project stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple learning deliverables, reviews, schedules, and priorities in a consulting environment.
* Professional, adaptable, self-directed, and customer-focused approach to delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with or exposure to Blue Yonder solutions or other enterprise supply chain solutions and platforms.
* Experience in supply chain, retail, manufacturing, logistics, planning, warehouse operations, transportation, or related business environments.
* Experience supporting learning and enablement for supply chain capabilities such as Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Integrated Business Planning, Allocation and Replenishment, Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, or related solutions.
* Experience supporting software implementations or broader business transformation programs.
* Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder discussions, hands-on learning, knowledge-transfer, or train-the-trainer programs.
* Familiarity with Prosci, ADKAR, SAP Activate, or other Organizational Change Management approaches.
* Experience with learning management systems, content development tools, digital learning, video, simulation, or related learning technologies.
* Professional services, enterprise software, or consulting experience.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Success means consistently delivering
**high-quality, customer-focused learning experiences**
that build learner proficiency and confidence, support successful knowledge transfer, and contribute to solution adoption and implementation success.
  
  
The EUT Consultant is expected to progressively develop from executing defined learning activities into independently conducting discovery, designing learning solutions, facilitating client sessions, advising stakeholders, and managing increasingly complex EUT deliverables.
  
  
Success is demonstrated through
**training effectiveness, learner proficiency, customer satisfaction, stakeholder relationships, solution adoption, and consistent delivery quality**
, while contributing to continuous improvement of EUT methodologies and learning assets.

title: Technical Specialist- ML Data
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
  
  
As a Technical Specialist, you will serve as the HYD based operational backbone of the Labeling Policy Program. You will play a key role in accelerating Behavior ML velocity by translating complex machine learning data requirements into consistent, high-quality, and scaleable labeling policies. You will drive rapid policy iteration, create critical golden datasets to enable fast labeling queue setup. This is an execution-focused role for a technical, detail-oriented specialist who thrives on driving clarity, alignment, and operational excellence in labeling workflows.
  
  
**You Will**

* Translate requirements to policies: Collaborate ML model owners / engineers to understand their specific data goals, translate their ambiguous machine learning requirements into precise labeling instructions, and publish clear, actionable labeling policies (with support from the US based counterparts and vendor partners).
* Drive queue readiness & golden datasets: Speed up the initial labeling queue setup process by executing rapid policy iterations and hand-crafting golden datasets (small-scale baseline datasets) to establish quality baselines before launching full-scale operations.
* Direct vendor teams: Provide technical guidance and operational direction to vendor labeling experts to enable rapid policy setup and ensure that the active labeling queues under your purview run smoothly and meet safety and performance objectives.
* Address edge cases & regional nuances: Provide critical, detailed inputs on long-tail edge cases and coordinate with regional country specialists to ensure country-specific driving rules and local nuances are accurately captured and validated, ahead of Waymo's deployment in these new countries.
* Enable quality and process improvements: Monitor labeling pipelines, conduct targeted technical analyses to identify data quality trends, and build/maintain automated data analysis tools to proactively identify improvements in the broader labeling workflow.
* Facilitate cross-functional knowledge sharing: Act as the primary technical interface between requesters and operations, ensuring on-ground dissipation of policies, managing policy amendments, and resolving complex escalations from requestors or vendor teams.

**You Have**

* 6+ years of experience in data analysis, operations, or program management with a focus on machine learning data annotation, taxonomy design, or human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Operational project management: Demonstrated ability to work independently on operational workflows and successfully project manage small sub-working groups or vendor squads.
* Core ML data lifecycle understanding: Practical knowledge of dataset curation, labeling pipelines, data quality control metrics, and baseline model evaluation concepts.
* Analytical aptitude: Experience conducting technical data analyses using pre-established tools (or building simple automation scripts) to diagnose pipeline issues, track vendor quality, and generate actionable insights.
* Adaptable & detail-oriented: Comfort working within a dynamic environment, translating vague technical needs into clear documentation, and maintaining a high standard of attention to detail.

**We Prefer**

* Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, SQL) or basic automation techniques to parse high volumes of critical data.
* Demonstrated ability to extract, manipulate, and apply machine learning techniques to high volumes of critical, product-related data.
* Demonstrated ability in working with a variety of engineering stakeholders to gather requirements, explain models, and iterate to make improvements.
* Prior experience working across multiple geographic locations and managing vendor-hosted operations.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

title: Manufacturing Senior Associate
description:
**Job Description**
**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**
At Amgen, our shared mission is to serve patients. Every team member contributes to our ability to consistently deliver high-quality medicines through excellence in operations, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The Manufacturing Senior Associate is responsible for the authoring, revision, coordination, and lifecycle management of Manufacturing controlled documents. This role partners closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Process Development, Engineering, Validation, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure procedures and documentation remain accurate, compliant, effective, and inspection-ready.
  
  
The individual serves as a key document management and process improvement resource, facilitating complex document revisions and authoring, coordinating stakeholder reviews, driving on-time completion of commitments, and supporting Manufacturing performance through effective documentation practices specifically in DS, DP, or FDP. In some instances may act as the overall business process owner for DS, DP, or FDP.
**Hours for this role may vary based on global time zones, which could include hybrid hours, on call requirements, and flexible working hours.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Document Authoring & Lifecycle Management**

* Author, revise, and maintain controlled GMP documents in collaboration with the document owner. Documents include:

+ Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
+ Forms
+ Protocols
+ Reports
+ Global Document Elements (GDEs)
+ Work Instructions
+ Training Documents
+ Other controlled GMP documentation

* Ensure documents comply with Good Documentation Practices (GDP), cGMP requirements, site procedures, and global standards.
* Perform periodic reviews of controlled documents and drive completion of required updates.
* Review existing procedures for accuracy, consistency, and process alignment.
* Identify opportunities to improve document effectiveness, usability, and compliance.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Facilitate document review meetings and revision workshops with subject matter experts and stakeholders, across various sites in the network
* Coordinate comment resolution across multiple functional groups.
* Consolidate feedback and incorporate approved revisions into final documents.
* Drive stakeholder alignment in partnership with the sponsoring area owner on document content, process changes, and implementation plans.
* Partner with Quality, Validation, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Technical Services to ensure documentation supports operational needs.

**Project & Revision Management**

* Manage multiple complex document revisions simultaneously.
* Develop and maintain document revision schedules and status trackers.
* Monitor progress against established timelines and commitments.
* Escalate risks, delays, and resource constraints as appropriate.
* Lead efforts to complete high-priority and inspection-related documentation updates.

**Metrics & Operational Support**

* Generate and analyze documentation performance metrics and reports.
* Track key performance indicators related to document health, overdue reviews, revision cycle times, and compliance commitments.
* Prepare performance metrics for communication to leadership and stakeholders
* Drive actions to improve documentation effectiveness, compliance, and right-first-time performance.
* Support audit and inspection readiness activities through documentation monitoring and reporting, if required.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to streamline documentation processes and workflows.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives and digital transformation efforts.
* Recommend and implement solutions that improve document quality, compliance, and efficiency.
* Contribute to standardization efforts across manufacturing organizations and sites.

**Basic Qualifications**
Graduation with 5 to 9 years of experience
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience authoring and revising SOPs, protocols, reports, forms, and controlled documentation.
* Strong technical writing and document management skills.
* Experience facilitating cross-functional meetings and stakeholder reviews.
* Knowledge of Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and cGMP requirements.
* Experience using electronic document management systems (e.g., Veeva, CDOCS, EDMS, TrackWise, etc.).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Experience generating and analyzing operational metrics and performance reports.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and facilitation skills.
* Experience leading continuous improvement initiatives.

**Competencies**
Consistent with the Manufacturing Senior Associate (GCF 4) competency model, success in this role requires demonstrated capability in:
  
  

* Demonstrating Technical Expertise
* Operating with Precision
* Working in Partnership
* Troubleshooting and Solving Problems
* Inspiring High Performance
* Striving for Your Best

**Key Measures of Success**

* On-time completion of document revisions
* Reduction in overdue document reviews
* Right-first-time document approval rate
* Cycle time for document revision and approval
* Compliance with GMP and documentation standards
* Inspection readiness and audit support effectiveness
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Continuous improvement implementation and value delivery

title: Specialist, Engineering Maintenance Solutions - HYD
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte as a Specialist, Engineering Maintenance Solutions, supporting controlled change and release activities across technology platforms. You will help assess change requests, coordinate release planning, manage dependencies and risks, and support stable deployments to live environments. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen service continuity through disciplined planning, transparent communication, and effective service-management practices.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Specialist, Engineering Maintenance Solutions on the Change & Release Management team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Execute Change and Release Management processes to help minimize service disruption and degradation throughout the change lifecycle.
* Coordinate change and release planning, including stakeholder communications, dependency management, conflict resolution, and prioritization.
* Plan and coordinate system testing, user acceptance testing, release activities, and deployments to support production readiness.
* Evaluate change requests for supported platforms; identify, analyze, and document risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation actions.
* Maintain change and release records, schedules, documentation, and status reporting to support governance and continuous service improvement.

**The team**
At Deloitte, we’re all about collaboration. And nowhere is this more apparent than among our 2,000-strong internal services team. With our combined specialist skills, we provide all the essential support and advice our client-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. Covering seven distinct areas; Human Resources, Clients & Industries, Finance & Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality & Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services & Real Estate, together we live, breathe and deliver the Deloitte experience.
  
  
Change Management: The quality control process that sets the stage ready by assessing, planning, and getting the right approvals for deployment of one or multiple changes and this ensures minimal disruption to live environment.
  
  
Release Management: Release management involves owning the release life cycle from assessment up and till deployment co-ordinating with the various build teams and testing teams along the way while maintaining the integrity of ongoing services.
  
  
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings:**
1-10 PM IST / 2-11 PM IST
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Experience supporting Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL)-aligned Change, Release, and Service Transition processes.
* Experience facilitating Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and coordinating change approvals.
* Experience planning and maintaining release schedules, dependencies, and deployment activities.
* Experience conducting change and release readiness assessments, including risk identification and mitigation documentation.
* Experience using Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) tools, such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or an equivalent platform, to track and manage changes and releases.
* Experience preparing change and release communications, operational documentation, and performance reports using Microsoft Office applications.
* ITIL v3 or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

Preferred:
  
  

* ITIL v3 or ITIL 4 certification above the Foundation level.
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Projects IN Controlled Environments (PRINCE2), or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification.
* Experience managing IT service delivery activities across change, release, incident, or problem management.
* Experience working with Agile delivery methods and DevOps practices.
* Lean or Six Sigma certification.
* Experience developing operational documentation and training materials.

This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document .
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
